items.title: 〈焦點股〉資金狂湧金融股 玉山金逼近50元 中信金、元大金齊刷新天價
items.title_en: Focus Stocks: Capital Floods Financial Shares; E.Sun Financial Near 50 TWD, CTBC Financial and Yuanta Financial Both Hit Record Highs
paras: 美國最新通膨數據高於預期，引發市場對美聯準會(Fed)持續升息的憂慮，美股昨夜全面重挫，賣壓迅速波及亞洲市場。今(15)日台股盤中更是重摔超過 1,800 點，市場恐慌情緒升溫。然而，在高利率環境有利銀行存放款利差的預期下，金融股逆勢成為資金最強避風港，其中多檔重量級金控上演「量價齊揚」大反攻，包括玉山金、中信金、元大金等股價接連刷寫歷史新高。
市場分析，若升息趨勢延續，銀行業的存款與放款利差可望擴大，加上外幣資產收益提升，吸引龐大避險資金轉進金融族群。民營金控今天表現尤為亮眼，漲幅普遍落在 2% 至 4% 之間。
玉山金(2884-TW)今日開高走高，盤中最高強勢攻上 49.5 元，大漲 4.65%，不僅逼近 50 元大關，更一舉刷新歷史新高紀錄。
中信金(2891-TW) 在海外布局與利差雙重題材加持下，盤中最高拉升至 73.6 元，漲幅達 3.08%，同步改寫歷史新高，整體公司市值更一舉突破 1.43 兆元關卡。
永豐金(2890-TW) 買盤追捧力道強勁，盤中最高觸及 45.9 元，勁揚逾 4%，距離歷史高點僅一步之遙。
除了銀行體系強勢之外，證券龍頭元大金(2885-TW) 今日亦展現抗跌韌性。儘管大盤面臨千點回檔賣壓，元大金仍獲買盤力挺逆勢翻紅，盤中最高來到 72.8 元，漲幅近 1%，續創歷史新天價，並穩穩站牢「兆元市值俱樂部」成員之位。
法人指出，在國際股市重挫、電子高本益比族群面臨估值修正之際，金控股憑藉著穩健的殖利率與升息帶來的利息淨收益(NII)正面助益，成為大盤震盪時的防禦首選。不過，投資人仍需留意高利率時間若過長，是否對銀行業持有的外幣債券造成未實現評價損失，以及對整體放款資產品質的影響。
paras_en: U.S. inflation data came in hotter than expected, sparking worries that the Federal Reserve will keep raising rates. U.S. equities slumped across the board last night, and the sell‑off quickly spread to Asian markets. On the 15th, Taiwan’s market tumbled more than 1,800 points intraday, stoking panic. Yet, in a high‑rate environment that favors banks’ net interest margins, financial stocks became the strongest safe haven, with several heavyweight financial holding companies staging a “price‑and‑volume surge” rally, including E.Sun Financial, CTBC Financial and Yuanta Financial, whose shares consecutively set new all‑time highs.

Analysts note that if the rate‑hike cycle continues, banks’ deposit‑to‑loan spreads are likely to widen, and higher foreign‑currency asset yields will draw massive safe‑haven capital into the financial sector. Private‑sector financial holdings shone today, with most gains ranging between 2% and 4%.
E.Sun Financial (2884‑TW) opened higher and kept climbing, hitting a intraday high of NT$49.5, up 4.65%, not only approaching the NT$50 threshold but also setting a fresh all‑time high record.

CTBC Financial (2891‑TW) rose to an intraday high of NT$73.6, up 3.08%, under the dual tailwinds of overseas expansion and widening spreads, rewriting its historical high and pushing the company’s total market value past the NT$1.43 trillion mark.
Yuanta Financial (2890‑TW) saw strong buying pressure, reaching an intraday high of NT$45.9, up more than 4%, just a step away from its previous record peak.

Beyond the banking sector’s strength, securities leader Yuanta Financial (2885‑TW) also showed resilience today. Despite the market facing a thousand‑point pull‑back, Yuanta Financial was buoyed by buying interest, turning red on the day and hitting an intraday high of NT$72.8, up nearly 1%, creating a new record high and firmly securing its place in the “trillion‑dollar market‑cap club.”

Institutional investors point out that amid global market crashes and valuation corrections in high‑P/E electronics stocks, financial holding companies benefit from solid dividend yields and the interest‑income boost from rate hikes, making them a defensive favorite during market turbulence. However, investors should watch for prolonged high‑rate periods that could cause unrealized losses on banks’ foreign‑currency bond holdings and affect the overall quality of loan assets.

items.title: 中國Q3手機出貨量寫13年來同期新低 前五名僅蘋果、華為成長
items.title_en: China Q3 Smartphone Shipments Hit Lowest Level Since 2013, Only Apple and Huawei See Growth Among Top Five
paras: 數據機構Omdia 14日（周三）發布的2026年第三季中國智慧手機統計數據顯示，本季中國國內智慧手機總出貨量為5,930萬台，較一年前下滑12%，寫下2013年以來同期最低出貨水準。
從廠商分項數據來看，華為以1,240萬台的季度出貨量位居中國國內市場第一，市佔率21%，出貨量較去年同期成長18%。
蘋果(AAPL-US) 緊隨其後，第三季出貨量為1,160萬台，市佔率20%，出貨量年增15%。
其餘本土品牌在第三季均出現不同程度下滑。vivo衰減24%，OPPO減少18%，小米(01810-HK) 下滑20%。其餘所有廠商合併出貨量為940萬台，較一年前大幅下降32%。
《界面新聞》指出，市場兩極分化的背後，記憶體成本居高不下是全行業共同面對的核心壓力。AI伺服器搶佔大量記憶體晶片產能，DRAM、NAND快閃記憶體價格持續走高，手機整機物料成本抬升。
在此背景下，廠商面臨兩難選擇：上調終端售價會抑制消費者換機意願，維持定價則壓縮利潤空間。
報告顯示，各大品牌採取了差異應對策略。華為依托新品迭代與存量用戶換機需求，持續深耕高階市場，依靠自研產品力減緩上游零件漲價帶來的衝擊。蘋果依靠成熟供應鏈議價能力，iPhone新品持續吸引中國高階消費群體。
vivo、OPPO、小米等品牌則選擇精簡產品線，放緩中低階機型上新節奏，資源向高階機型傾斜，控制產能，減少庫存積壓風險。
Omdia首席分析師侯林在報告中表示，記憶體價格在第三季來到階段性高點，成本壓力自上而下傳導至終端產品，給各品牌出貨表現帶來不同程度衝擊，市場分化進一步加劇。
paras_en: Data firm Omdia released its Q3 2026 China smartphone statistics on Wednesday, the 14th, showing total domestic smartphone shipments of 59.3 million units, down 12% year‑on‑year and marking the lowest level for the same period since 2013.
Looking at shipments by manufacturer, Huawei led the Chinese market with 12.4 million units shipped in the quarter, a 21% market share and an 18% increase over the same period last year.
Apple (AAPL‑US) was close behind, shipping 11.6 million units in Q3, a 20% market share and a 15% year‑on‑year increase.

Other domestic brands all saw declines in the quarter: vivo fell 24%, OPPO dropped 18%, and Xiaomi (01810‑HK) slipped 20%. The remaining manufacturers combined shipped 9.4 million units, a sharp 32% drop from a year earlier.

Jiemian News noted that behind the market’s polarization, persistently high memory‑chip costs are a core pressure facing the entire industry, as AI servers soak up large amounts of DRAM and NAND capacity, driving up prices and raising the material cost of phones.
In this context, manufacturers face a dilemma: raising retail prices could dampen consumer upgrade intent, while keeping prices steady squeezes profit margins.

The report shows that major brands have adopted different strategies. Huawei is leveraging new‑model iterations and existing‑user upgrades to deepen its high‑end market presence, using its own‑developed products to cushion the impact of upstream component price hikes. Apple relies on its mature supply‑chain bargaining power, with new iPhone models continuing to attract China’s high‑end consumer segment.

Brands such as vivo, OPPO and Xiaomi are streamlining their product lines, slowing the rollout of mid‑ and low‑end models, shifting resources toward high‑end devices, controlling capacity and reducing inventory‑stock risk.

Omdia chief analyst Hou Lin said in the report that memory prices peaked in Q3, transmitting cost pressure from the top down to end products and affecting each brand’s shipment performance to varying degrees, further intensifying market segmentation.

items.title: 傳字節跳動洽購聯發科AI晶片 有望成Google後第二家主要ASIC客戶
items.title_en: ByteDance in Talks to Purchase MediaTek AI Chips, Potentially Becoming Its Second Major ASIC Customer After Google
paras: 《彭博》週四 (15 日) 報導，TikTok母公司字節跳動與聯發科 (2454-TW) 的資料中心客製化晶片採購談判已進入深入階段，雙方接近達成協議。若交易敲定，字節跳動有望成為繼Google之後，聯發科第二家主要特殊應用積體電路 (ASIC) 客戶，為聯發科拓展資料中心業務增添動能。
知情人士透露，聯發科將供應依照字節跳動平台需求客製化設計的ASIC，支援其資料中心運作，但未透露供貨數量。
字節跳動未立即回應置評請求，聯發科則不予置評。
字節跳動正擴大硬體投資，押注人工智慧 (AI) 成為下一波成長引擎。
然而，與阿里巴巴 (BABA-US) 和騰訊 (0700-HK) 等中國同業一樣，字節跳動受美國出口管制限制，無法取得輝達 (NVDA-US) 等業者最先進的AI晶片，華為等中國供應商也無法滿足所有需求，促使其尋求其他供應來源。
報導指出，與晶片設計業者合作，是字節跳動探索的替代方案之一。依現行美國出口管制規定，只要相關AI運算能力未超過特定門檻，這類合作仍獲允許。
《彭博》先前曾報導，字節跳動今年稍早已與高通 (QCOM-US) 達成類似協議，採購數百萬顆AI晶片。
對聯發科而言，若能取得字節跳動的大規模訂單，將有助於業務多元化、降低對手機市場的依賴，並強化其在資料中心領域與高通、博通 (AVGO-US) 競爭的能力。科技大廠積極開發AI客製化晶片，也讓聯發科得以運用行動處理器設計經驗，擴大參與資料中心基礎建設商機。
聯發科預估，2026年相關AI晶片業務營收約達20億美元，並估計2027年客製化AI ASIC潛在市場規模可達700億至800億美元，以爭取10%至15%市占率為目標。
輝達8月底宣布，將認購聯發科35億美元可轉換公司債，並擴大雙方在AI領域的合作。隨著客製化晶片業務受到市場關注，據《彭博》報導，聯發科市值約2,100億美元，以市值計為僅次於台積電 (2330-TW、TSM-US) 的台灣第二大企業。
字節跳動的晶片需求，則來自持續擴大的AI基礎建設計畫。
《彭博》報導，該公司正考慮將今年資本支出提高至最多700億美元，超過去年的2倍，用於擴建資料中心及其他AI設施。若經濟與營運條件有利，2027年支出可能進一步增至1,000億美元。公司已於9月取得300億美元貸款，支應相關投資。
這波投資反映字節跳動正加快布局，力求鞏固在聊天機器人與AI影片等領域的早期優勢，並擴大海外影響力。旗下Seedance等主力模型，正面對阿里巴巴Happy Horse、快手 (1024-HK) 可靈AI及Google等對手的競爭。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg reported on Thursday (the 15th) that TikTok parent ByteDance and MediaTek (2454-TW) have entered deep negotiations over custom data‑center chips, with both sides close to reaching an agreement. If the deal closes, ByteDance could become MediaTek’s second major ASIC customer after Google, adding momentum to MediaTek’s data‑center business expansion.

Sources familiar with the matter said MediaTek will supply ASICs custom‑designed to ByteDance’s platform requirements to support its data‑center operations, though the supply volume was not disclosed.
ByteDance did not immediately respond to requests for comment, and MediaTek declined to comment.
ByteDance is expanding its hardware investments, betting that artificial intelligence will be the next growth engine.

However, like Chinese peers such as Alibaba (BABA-US) and Tencent (0700-HK), ByteDance is constrained by U.S. export controls and cannot obtain the most advanced AI chips from companies like Nvidia (NVDA-US); Chinese suppliers such as Huawei also cannot meet all its needs, prompting it to look for alternative sources.

The report noted that partnering with chip designers is one of ByteDance’s explored alternatives. Under current U.S. export rules, such collaborations are still permitted as long as the AI compute capability does not exceed a certain threshold.
Bloomberg previously reported that ByteDance earlier this year reached a similar agreement with Qualcomm (QCOM-US) to purchase millions of AI chips.

For MediaTek, securing a large‑scale order from ByteDance would help diversify its business, reduce reliance on the smartphone market, and strengthen its ability to compete with Qualcomm and Broadcom (AVGO-US) in the data‑center arena. The tech giant’s push into AI‑custom chips also lets MediaTek leverage its mobile processor design expertise to capture more data‑center infrastructure opportunities.

MediaTek estimates that revenue from related AI chips could reach about $2 billion in 2026, and it projects the potential market for custom AI ASICs to be $70‑80 billion in 2027, targeting a 10‑15% market share.

Nvidia announced at the end of August that it would purchase $3.5 billion of MediaTek convertible bonds and expand cooperation in AI. As custom‑chip business draws market attention, Bloomberg said MediaTek’s market value is roughly $210 billion, making it Taiwan’s second‑largest company by market cap after TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US).
ByteDance’s chip demand stems from its continuously expanding AI infrastructure plans.

Bloomberg reported the company is considering raising its capital expenditure this year to as much as $70 billion, double last year’s level, to expand data‑centers and other AI facilities. If economic and operational conditions are favorable, spending could rise to $100 billion in 2027. The firm secured a $30 billion loan in September to fund these investments.

The investment wave reflects ByteDance’s accelerated rollout to cement early advantages in chat‑bots and AI‑generated video, while expanding its overseas influence. Its flagship models such as Seedance face competition from Alibaba’s Happy Horse, Kuaishou (1024‑HK)’s Keling AI, Google and others.
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication)

items.title: Arm敗訴僅賠高通2美元！數十億美元權利金豁免成決戰關鍵
items.title_en: Arm Loses Lawsuit but Pays Qualcomm Only $2! Billion‑Dollar Royalty Waiver Becomes Decisive Issue
paras: 美國德拉瓦州聯邦陪審團10月13日作出裁決，認定晶片技術供應商Arm違反與高通(QCOM-US)的許可協議，並故意干預高通(QCOM-US)與Meta Platforms(META-US)的商業關係。然而，陪審團僅判處Arm向高通支付2美元的名義損害賠償，使得雙方均從裁決中尋得「勝利」的依據。
這項象徵性賠償背後，真正左右未來格局的將是接下來即將裁定的五年權利金豁免問題，涉及金額可能高達數十億美元。
經過為期五天的審理，德拉瓦州陪審團認定Arm違反了其與高通長期有效的架構許可協議（ALA），具體表現為未能履行向高通提供晶片設計所需軟體修補程式和測試工具的義務。此外，陪審團還認定Arm故意且過失地干預了高通與Meta之間的商業關係。
高通此前指控稱，2024年公司與Meta的一筆晶片供應協議已接近達成，但Arm向《彭博社》洩露了高通違反許可協議的通知，導致Meta對高通的授權狀態產生疑慮，交易因此被推遲，協議價值縮水約1.7億美元。
然而，儘管兩項指控成立，陪審團對每項違規僅判處1美元賠償，合計2美元。此外，陪審團還在高通提出的另外五項違約指控中，作出了有利於Arm的認定。
高通僅獲得2美元的賠償金額看似荒誕，實則具有明確的法律意涵。名義損害（nominal damages）賠償的判處意味著陪審團認可了高通指控Arm存在法律上的過錯，但認為高通未能證明其遭受了可直接量化的經濟損失。
Arm的律師也表示，高通所謂的損害更多是推測性的，而非實質性的財務損失。
正因如此，雙方在裁決後都迅速發表聲明，各自宣示「勝利」。
高通的聲明強調：「我們感到欣慰，因為陪審團認定Arm違反了雙方長期有效的架構許可協議，未能兌現承諾，並故意採取行動擾亂高通的業務。」高通還表示，這一結果「進一步暴露了Arm損害高通及其生態系統的更廣泛意圖」。
Arm的回應同樣積極：「我們對陪審團的裁決感到滿意，該裁決在四項訴求上支持Arm，並就高通另外兩項訴求分別僅判賠1美元。」Arm強調，這一結果「印證了Arm在技術許可協議項下出於善意行事」。
五年權利金豁免懸而未決
本次法庭裁決的2美元賠償金本身無關痛癢，但其背後的違約認定卻為高通打開了通往更大法律利益的大門。
高通正在尋求依據許可協議中的一項條款，主張由於Arm違約，高通有權在五年內停止向Arm支付權利金。據《路透社》報導，這筆金額可能高達數十億美元。Arm則主張，該五年權利金罰則條款「無法強制執行」。
此爭議將由美國聯邦地區法官Maryellen Noreika裁決，而非陪審團。Noreika法官同時還需裁定另一項關鍵問題：Arm是否就下一代技術（ARMv10）與高通進行了善意協商。
庭審中披露的一個細節加劇了雙方在下一代技術定價上的對立：高通的律師引用圖表顯示，Arm尋求將其計算架構從第9版升級到第10版時，專利費提高1800%。而Arm的律師則反問高通執行長安蒙，2013年協議中每顆晶片1.88美元的專利費上限，在資料中心晶片擁有288個核心的2026年是否還合理。
可以說，Noreika法官後續關於五年權利金豁免的認定，將決定高通與Arm這場法律戰的實際經濟後果。無論結果如何，敗訴一方幾乎必然會提起上訴，這場橫跨數年的晶片巨頭法律戰遠未到終局。
paras_en: On October 13, a federal jury in Delaware ruled that chip‑technology supplier Arm violated its licensing agreement with Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) and deliberately interfered with Qualcomm’s business relationship with Meta Platforms (META‑US). However, the jury awarded only a nominal $2 in damages to Qualcomm, allowing both sides to claim a "victory" from the verdict.

Behind this symbolic award, the real determinant of the future landscape will be the upcoming decision on a five‑year royalty‑waiver issue that could involve amounts in the tens of billions of dollars.

After a five‑day trial, the Delaware jury found that Arm breached its long‑standing Architecture License Agreement (ALA) with Qualcomm by failing to provide the software patches and testing tools needed for chip design. The jury also concluded that Arm deliberately and negligently interfered with Qualcomm’s commercial relationship with Meta.

Qualcomm had previously alleged that a chip‑supply deal with Meta in 2024 was close to completion, but Arm leaked to Bloomberg that Qualcomm had violated the licensing agreement, causing Meta to doubt Qualcomm’s licensing status. The deal was delayed and its value shrank by about $170 million.

Nevertheless, although both allegations were upheld, the jury awarded only $1 in damages for each violation, totaling $2. In addition, the jury ruled in favor of Arm on five other breach claims raised by Qualcomm.

Qualcomm’s $2 award may seem absurd, but it carries a clear legal meaning. The nominal‑damages award indicates that the jury recognized Qualcomm’s claim that Arm committed a legal wrong, but found that Qualcomm failed to prove any directly quantifiable economic loss.
Arm’s lawyers also said that Qualcomm’s alleged damages are largely speculative rather than actual financial losses.
For that reason, both parties quickly issued statements after the verdict, each proclaiming a "victory."

Qualcomm’s statement emphasized: "We are pleased that the jury found Arm breached the long‑standing Architecture License Agreement, failed to fulfill its commitments, and deliberately acted to disrupt Qualcomm’s business." Qualcomm added that the result "further exposes Arm’s broader intent to harm Qualcomm and its ecosystem."

Arm’s response was equally upbeat: "We are satisfied with the jury’s decision, which supports Arm on four of the claims and awards only $1 for each of Qualcomm’s two remaining claims." Arm stressed that the outcome "confirms that Arm acted in good faith under the technology licensing agreement."
Five‑Year Royalty Waiver Still Unresolved
The $2 damages award itself is immaterial, but the breach findings open the door for Qualcomm to pursue much larger legal benefits.

Qualcomm is seeking to invoke a clause in the licensing agreement that, because of Arm’s breach, gives Qualcomm the right to stop paying royalties to Arm for five years. Reuters reports that the amount at stake could reach tens of billions of dollars. Arm argues that the five‑year royalty‑penalty clause "cannot be enforced."

The dispute will be decided by U.S. District Judge Maryellen Noreika, not the jury. Judge Noreika must also rule on another key issue: whether Arm engaged in good‑faith negotiations with Qualcomm over next‑generation technology (ARMv10).

A detail revealed during the trial heightened the pricing clash over next‑generation tech: Qualcomm’s lawyers presented a chart showing that when Arm sought to upgrade its compute architecture from version 9 to version 10, patent fees jumped 1,800%. Arm’s counsel retorted by asking Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon whether the 2013 agreement’s $1.88 per‑chip patent‑fee cap remains reasonable in 2026, when data‑center chips have 288 cores.

Judge Noreika’s forthcoming ruling on the five‑year royalty waiver will determine the actual economic outcome of the legal battle between Qualcomm and Arm. Regardless of the result, the losing party is almost certain to appeal, and this multi‑year chip‑giant lawsuit is far from over.

items.title: 台達電鄭平：三因素限制電力設施建置 供電缺口成AI發展關鍵挑戰
items.title_en: Delta Electronics' Zheng Ping: Three Factors Restrict Power Facility Construction, Power Supply Gap Becomes Key AI Development Challenge
paras: 台達電(2308-TW)董事長鄭平今(15)日表示，AI資料中心快速擴張，全球電力需求持續攀升，但電力基礎設施建置受到法規、設備使用年限及投資報酬率等因素限制，電力供應難以跟上AI產業的擴張速度，將成為AI發展的重要挑戰。
鄭平指出，AI帶動雲端服務供應商(CSP)資本支出快速成長，美國四大CSP近年資本支出預估將達2022年的4.7倍，但電力系統投資成長幅度僅約1.8倍。美國預估到2028年，新增資料中心用電需求將達44GW，但電網新增供電能力僅25GW，兩者相差19GW。
他表示，其他國家也面臨類似問題，部分地區已開始限制資料中心用電，或要求大型資料中心必須具備自有供電能力，顯示電力供應已成為AI基礎設施建置的重要課題。
除了AI資料中心，電氣化也將持續推升整體用電需求。鄭平表示，全球目前平均電氣化程度約21%，台灣約30%，而交通運輸、工業等領域仍有大量能源仰賴天然氣、煤炭及其他燃料。隨著電動車、資料中心及建築自動化等應用發展，預估未來10年電動車用電量將成長至目前的5倍，資料中心到2030年的用電量則可達去年的3倍左右。
鄭平指出，推動電氣化除了能擴大綠色電力的使用，也是能源轉型與減碳的重要方向，但在電力需求持續增加、供電建設又相對受限的情況下，如何確保電力供應穩定並提升能源使用效率，將是未來的重要挑戰。
針對這項需求，台達電已投入超過10年建構微電網相關解決方案。鄭平表示，大型AI資料中心不能只考量內部供電及散熱，還必須從整體電力系統著手，涵蓋發電、輸電、配電、儲能及用電管理，透過整合各環節提升能源使用效率。台達電過去主要著重於用電端，如今已逐步擴大至整體能源管理。
在產品方面，台達電推出固態氧化物燃料電池(SOFC)與固態變壓器(SST)。鄭平指出，SOFC可使用氫氣或天然氣發電，搭配能源回收後，整體能源利用效率可達85%，並可採分散式方式建置，預計明年量產。
至於SST，則可減少傳統資料中心供電架構中的多次電力轉換，並將電力轉換為800V直流電，提升整體能源轉換效率。鄭平表示，台達電也將SST整合為預製式系統，在工廠完成組裝後再運送至客戶端，以簡化現場建置流程。
paras_en: Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) Chairman Zheng Ping said on the 15th that the rapid expansion of AI data centers is driving a continuous rise in global electricity demand, but the construction of power infrastructure is constrained by regulations, equipment lifespan and investment return rates, making power supply unable to keep pace with AI industry growth and posing a major challenge for AI development.

Zheng noted that AI is spurring fast growth in capital expenditures by cloud service providers (CSPs). The four major U.S. CSPs are projected to increase capex to 4.7 times the 2022 level in recent years, while investment in power systems is expected to grow only about 1.8 times. The U.S. estimates that by 2028 new data‑center electricity demand will reach 44 GW, but the grid’s added supply capacity will be only 25 GW, leaving a 19 GW shortfall.

He added that other countries face similar issues; some regions have begun limiting data‑center electricity use or requiring large data centers to have their own power supply, underscoring that power supply has become a critical issue for AI infrastructure deployment.

Beyond AI data centers, electrification will continue to lift overall electricity demand. Zheng said the world’s average electrification level is about 21%, Taiwan’s about 30%, and sectors such as transportation and industry still rely heavily on natural gas, coal and other fuels. With the growth of electric vehicles, data centers and building automation, he estimates EV electricity consumption will rise to five times current levels within ten years, and data‑center consumption could reach roughly three times last year’s level by 2030.

Zheng pointed out that promoting electrification not only expands the use of green power but is also a key direction for energy transition and carbon reduction. However, with rising power demand and relatively limited supply construction, ensuring stable power supply and improving energy use efficiency will be a major future challenge.

In response to this need, Delta Electronics has invested more than ten years in developing micro‑grid solutions. Zheng said large AI data centers cannot focus solely on internal power and cooling; they must address the entire power system, covering generation, transmission, distribution, storage and load management, and improve energy efficiency through integrated solutions. Delta previously emphasized the consumption side but is now expanding to overall energy management.

On the product side, Delta introduced solid‑oxide fuel cells (SOFC) and solid‑state transformers (SST). Zheng explained that SOFCs can generate power from hydrogen or natural gas, achieving overall energy utilization efficiencies of up to 85% when combined with energy recovery, and can be deployed in a distributed manner, with mass production slated for next year.

Regarding SSTs, they can reduce multiple power conversions in traditional data‑center supply architectures and convert power to 800 V DC, boosting overall energy conversion efficiency. Zheng said Delta will also integrate SSTs into prefabricated systems that are assembled in factories and then shipped to customers, simplifying on‑site installation.

items.title_en: Focus Stocks: Taiwan Market Plunges Over 1,000 Points, Telecom Trio Becomes Safe‑Haven as All Rise
paras: 台股今(15)日狂瀉超過1700點，資金流往電信三雄避風頭，中華電信(2412-TW)、台灣大(3045-TW)以及遠傳(4904-TW)紛紛走揚，其中，中華電信及台灣大股價創高，遠傳則挑戰前高。

paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market tumbled more than 1,700 points today (Oct. 15), with capital flowing into the three telecom giants as a safe haven. Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW), Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) and Far EasTone (4904‑TW) all rallied, with Chunghwa and Taiwan Mobile hitting record highs and Far EasTone testing its previous peak.

Chunghwa Telecom rose intraday to a high of NT$154, up over 3%, while Taiwan Mobile surged to NT$133, up more than 4%, both setting all‑time highs. Far EasTone peaked at NT$113, a gain of over 4%, challenging its prior high of NT$113.5. Trading volume for all three telecom stocks exploded, each exceeding 10,000 lots.

The telecoms’ core businesses are benefiting simultaneously from the launch of Apple’s new iPhone 18 Pro series, which boosted September revenue and profit. Chunghwa Telecom, in particular, saw the effects of its asset‑revitalisation strategy, recognizing related revenue and posting a September EPS of NT$0.57, keeping it atop the one‑month profit leaderboard. Chunghwa said the strategy will focus on a “lease‑instead‑of‑sale” model to sustain recurring income.

All three telecoms delivered strong financial results for the first three quarters. Chunghwa posted a post‑tax profit of NT$32.97 billion, up 12.1% year‑on‑year, with EPS of NT$4.25. Taiwan Mobile earned NT$12.95 billion, up 22.87% YoY, with EPS of NT$4.26. Far EasTone reported NT$11.392 billion in profit, up 13.24% YoY, with EPS of NT$3.16. Taiwan Mobile’s EPS was only NT$0.01 lower than Chunghwa’s, making Taiwan Mobile the profit leader for the first three quarters.

items.title: 一檔股票拖垮全球半導體？財經名嘴：美晶片股是看SK海力士臉色　不是輝達
items.title_en: One Stock Dragging Down Global Semiconductors? CNBC Host: US Chip Stocks Follow SK Hynix, Not Nvidia
paras: SK海力士正處於全球記憶體晶片拋售潮風暴中心，近六日ADR股價跌逾15%，今(15)日早盤在南韓市場崩逾10%，美光、西部數據、希捷週三(14日)跌近2%。對此《CNBC》名嘴Jim Cramer指出，SK海力士與SMH半導體ETF成分股高度連動，美股晶片族群更跟海力士連動，非只跟輝達，其記憶體業務規模與價格指標意義，令SK海力士成為更廣泛半導體賣壓的領頭羊。
晶片股拋售潮表面上是獲利了結，深層則在重估三件事：一是中國長鑫存儲推進4F²架構、預計今年底推出伺服器DDR5，通用DRAM與伺服器記憶體供給預期生變；二是AI資本支出回報受質疑，市場怕HBM漲價循環見頂；三是利率走高壓縮高成長股容錯空間。
Roundhill策略師Drew Pettit表示，記憶體類股經過獲利預期大幅上修後進入「轉型期」，投資人開始追問成長能否延續，任何負面消息都被放大。
不過，中國威脅目前有邊界。美國財富管理與投行D.A. Davidson董事總經理Gil Luria表示，長鑫存儲份額與技術確實提升，但主力仍在通用DRAM及中低端，HBM由SK海力士、三星主導，且難供應微軟、谷歌、亞馬遜、蘋果、輝達等美系大客戶。若僅計算通用記憶體價格壓力，SK海力士、三星受影響較大，美光相對免疫。
Luria也對半導體週期仍偏樂觀，理由是中國AI供應鏈業績、展望與能見度改善。
對SK海力士而言，短線要看中國擴產、外資賣超與HBM毛利可持續性；中長線仍看SK海力士在高堆疊HBM的領先地位與AI伺服器綁定。
Cramer建議別只盯短線，應回到AI系統與終端設備記憶體需求成長，但在估值已反映高預期下，任何量產遞延、客戶驗證或中國低價滲透消息，都可能繼續放大波動。
paras_en: SK Hynix is at the center of a global memory chip sell‑off storm, with its ADR falling more than 15% over the past six days and its South Korean market price plunging over 10% in early trading today (the 15th). Micron, Western Digital and Seagate each slipped about 2% on Wednesday (the 14th). CNBC host Jim Cramer noted that SK Hynix is highly correlated with the SMH semiconductor ETF, and that U.S. chip stocks are moving in tandem with Hynix—not just Nvidia—because its memory business size and pricing benchmarks make SK Hynix the leading driver of broader semiconductor selling pressure.

The chip‑stock sell‑off looks on the surface like profit‑taking, but deeper it reflects a re‑evaluation of three factors: first, China’s ChangXin Memory is advancing its 4F² architecture and expects to launch server DDR5 by year‑end, potentially reshaping supply of commodity DRAM and server memory; second, the return on AI capital expenditures is being questioned, with the market fearing that the HBM price‑rise cycle may have peaked; third, rising interest rates are compressing the margin for error in high‑growth stocks.

Roundhill strategist Drew Pettit said memory stocks have entered a "transformation phase" after profit expectations were sharply upgraded, and investors are now probing whether growth can be sustained, so any negative news gets amplified.

However, the Chinese threat has limits. Gil Luria, managing director at U.S. wealth‑management and investment‑banking firm D.A. Davidson, said ChangXin’s market share and technology are indeed improving, but its focus remains on commodity DRAM and mid‑to‑low‑end segments. HBM is dominated by SK Hynix and Samsung and is difficult to supply to major U.S. customers such as Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Apple and Nvidia. If you look only at pressure on commodity memory prices, SK Hynix and Samsung are more affected, while Micron is relatively insulated.
Luria also remains somewhat optimistic about the semiconductor cycle, citing improving performance, outlook and visibility for China’s AI supply chain.

For SK Hynix, the short‑term outlook hinges on Chinese capacity expansion, foreign‑investor net selling, and the sustainability of HBM margins; the medium‑to‑long term still depends on SK Hynix’s leading position in high‑stack HBM and its tie‑in with AI servers.

Cramer advises not to focus solely on the short term but to return to the growth in memory demand from AI systems and end‑device equipment. Yet, with valuations already reflecting lofty expectations, any delays in mass production, customer validation issues, or news of low‑price penetration from China could continue to magnify volatility.

items.title: 波克夏加碼3.3億美元入股 Bending Spoons暴漲超40%
items.title_en: Berkshire Adds $330 Million Stake in Bending Spoons, Shares Surge Over 40%
paras: 多家外媒報導，義大利軟體收購業者 Bending Spoons (BSP-US) 獲波克夏·海瑟威 (BRK.B-US) 追加投資3.3億美元，帶動股價週三 (14日) 飆漲逾40%。然而，這家公司的估值並不便宜，也讓向來重視價值的波克夏為何出手，成為市場關注焦點。
根據證券申報文件，Bending Spoons 將以每股33美元，向波克夏發行1,000萬股普通股，交易完成後，波克夏持股比重將達4%。此次募得資金將提高公司推動收購的財務彈性。
這是波克夏今年第二度投資 Bending Spoons。今年7月，該公司於那斯達克首次公開發行股票 (IPO) 時，波克夏已投入6億美元，加計此次追加投資，累計投入達9.3億美元。隨著股價大漲，波克夏這筆持股的帳面獲利估計已達約6億美元。
不過，依週三公告揭露的股數推算，Bending Spoons 市值約400億美元，IPO時另有約40億美元債務。若以股權市值加計債務的企業價值衡量，估值接近預估年營收的10倍；以2027年預估獲利計算，本益比則約30倍。
這樣的買進估值，與波克夏過往部分大型投資形成鮮明對比。巴菲特 (Warren Buffett) 師承價值投資大師葛拉漢，長期重視買進價格與企業價值之間的關係。即使是波克夏最成功的股票投資之一、目前最大持股蘋果 (AAPL-US)，在2016年至2018年大舉買進時，本益比也不到15倍。
Bending Spoons 主要透過收購軟體及訂閱制應用程式拓展事業版圖。共同創辦人暨企業收購主管 Francesco Patarnello 表示，公司持續評估併購機會，目前潛在交易案源仍相當充足。
Patarnello 認為，波克夏追加投資反映其對公司團隊與營運平台的信心，也將強化財務調度能力，協助公司配合整體融資策略，把握具吸引力的收購機會。
支持者則看好 Bending Spoons 收購後的整合與經營能力。Durable Capital Partners 創辦人暨投資長 Henry Ellenbogen 今年7月表示，看好該公司每名員工創造的營收及稅息折舊攤銷前獲利 (EBITDA) 持續提升，進而推動內生成長，並讓營收擴張帶來更大幅度的獲利成長。
從波克夏整體布局來看，這家投資集團近一年也增加了科技股投資，目前持有逾1億股 Alphabet (GOOGL-US)，其中包括今年6月以每股不到350美元、斥資100億美元買進的部位。
不過，Alphabet 的買進由巴菲特主導，Bending Spoons 這筆投資究竟由誰拍板，目前仍不清楚。
阿貝爾 (Greg Abel) 今年初接替巴菲特出任波克夏執行長，目前負責監督約3,500億美元的股票投資組合。投資經理魏許勒 (Ted Weschler) 管理其中約6%，巴菲特也仍參與投資決策。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported that Italian software‑acquisition firm Bending Spoons (BSP‑US) received an additional $330 million investment from Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B‑US), sending its stock up more than 40% on Wednesday (the 14th). The company’s valuation is far from cheap, prompting market observers to wonder why value‑focused Berkshire would step in.

According to securities filing documents, Bending Spoons will issue 10 million common shares to Berkshire at $33 per share, giving Berkshire a 4% ownership stake after the transaction. The capital raised will increase the company’s financial flexibility for future acquisitions.

This is Berkshire’s second investment in Bending Spoons this year. When the company went public on Nasdaq in July, Berkshire had already put $600 million into it; with the new infusion, total investment reaches $930 million. The share price jump means Berkshire’s paper profit on the holding is now roughly $600 million.

Based on the share count disclosed on Wednesday, Bending Spoons is valued at about $40 billion, with roughly $4 billion of debt at IPO. Measured by equity market cap plus debt (enterprise value), the valuation is close to ten times projected 2027 revenue; using projected 2027 earnings, the price‑to‑earnings multiple is about 30×.

Such a purchase price contrasts sharply with many of Berkshire’s past large‑cap bets. Warren Buffett, a disciple of value‑investing guru Graham, has long emphasized the relationship between purchase price and intrinsic value. Even Berkshire’s most successful equity holding, Apple (AAPL‑US), was bought at a P/E below 15× during the massive 2016‑2018 buying spree.

Bending Spoons expands its business mainly through acquiring software and subscription‑based apps. Co‑founder and corporate‑development head Francesco Patarnello said the company continues to evaluate acquisition opportunities and that the pipeline of potential deals remains robust.

Patarnello believes Berkshire’s follow‑on investment reflects confidence in the team and operating platform, and will strengthen financial flexibility, helping the company execute its broader financing strategy and seize attractive acquisition targets.

Supporters are optimistic about Bending Spoons’ post‑acquisition integration and operating capabilities. Henry Ellenbogen, founder and CIO of Durable Capital Partners, said in July he is bullish on the firm’s per‑employee revenue and EBITDA growth, which should drive organic expansion and translate revenue growth into outsized profit gains.

Looking at Berkshire’s overall positioning, the conglomerate has increased its tech‑stock exposure over the past year, now holding more than 100 million shares of Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), including a $10 billion purchase in June at just under $350 per share.
However, the Alphabet purchase was led by Buffett himself, and it remains unclear who approved the Bending Spoons investment.

Greg Abel took over from Buffett as Berkshire’s CEO earlier this year and now oversees roughly $350 billion of equity holdings. Investment manager Ted Weschler runs about 6% of that portfolio, while Buffett still participates in investment decisions.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉資金狂湧金融股 玉山金逼近50元 中信金、元大金齊刷新天價
items.title_en: Focus Stocks: Capital Floods Financial Shares; E.Sun Financial Near 50 TWD, CTBC Financial and Yuanta Financial Both Hit Record Highs
paras: 美國最新通膨數據高於預期，引發市場對美聯準會(Fed)持續升息的憂慮，美股昨夜全面重挫，賣壓迅速波及亞洲市場。今(15)日台股盤中更是重摔超過 1,800 點，市場恐慌情緒升溫。然而，在高利率環境有利銀行存放款利差的預期下，金融股逆勢成為資金最強避風港，其中多檔重量級金控上演「量價齊揚」大反攻，包括玉山金、中信金、元大金等股價接連刷寫歷史新高。
市場分析，若升息趨勢延續，銀行業的存款與放款利差可望擴大，加上外幣資產收益提升，吸引龐大避險資金轉進金融族群。民營金控今天表現尤為亮眼，漲幅普遍落在 2% 至 4% 之間。
玉山金(2884-TW)今日開高走高，盤中最高強勢攻上 49.5 元，大漲 4.65%，不僅逼近 50 元大關，更一舉刷新歷史新高紀錄。
中信金(2891-TW) 在海外布局與利差雙重題材加持下，盤中最高拉升至 73.6 元，漲幅達 3.08%，同步改寫歷史新高，整體公司市值更一舉突破 1.43 兆元關卡。
永豐金(2890-TW) 買盤追捧力道強勁，盤中最高觸及 45.9 元，勁揚逾 4%，距離歷史高點僅一步之遙。
除了銀行體系強勢之外，證券龍頭元大金(2885-TW) 今日亦展現抗跌韌性。儘管大盤面臨千點回檔賣壓，元大金仍獲買盤力挺逆勢翻紅，盤中最高來到 72.8 元，漲幅近 1%，續創歷史新天價，並穩穩站牢「兆元市值俱樂部」成員之位。
法人指出，在國際股市重挫、電子高本益比族群面臨估值修正之際，金控股憑藉著穩健的殖利率與升息帶來的利息淨收益(NII)正面助益，成為大盤震盪時的防禦首選。不過，投資人仍需留意高利率時間若過長，是否對銀行業持有的外幣債券造成未實現評價損失，以及對整體放款資產品質的影響。
paras_en: U.S. inflation data came in hotter than expected, sparking worries that the Federal Reserve will keep raising rates. U.S. equities slumped across the board last night, and the sell‑off quickly spread to Asian markets. On the 15th, Taiwan’s market tumbled more than 1,800 points intraday, stoking panic. Yet, in a high‑rate environment that favors banks’ net interest margins, financial stocks became the strongest safe haven, with several heavyweight financial holding companies staging a “price‑and‑volume surge” rally, including E.Sun Financial, CTBC Financial and Yuanta Financial, whose shares consecutively set new all‑time highs.

Analysts note that if the rate‑hike cycle continues, banks’ deposit‑to‑loan spreads are likely to widen, and higher foreign‑currency asset yields will draw massive safe‑haven capital into the financial sector. Private‑sector financial holdings shone today, with most gains ranging between 2% and 4%.
E.Sun Financial (2884‑TW) opened higher and kept climbing, hitting a intraday high of NT$49.5, up 4.65%, not only approaching the NT$50 threshold but also setting a fresh all‑time high record.

CTBC Financial (2891‑TW) rose to an intraday high of NT$73.6, up 3.08%, under the dual tailwinds of overseas expansion and widening spreads, rewriting its historical high and pushing the company’s total market value past the NT$1.43 trillion mark.
Yuanta Financial (2890‑TW) saw strong buying pressure, reaching an intraday high of NT$45.9, up more than 4%, just a step away from its previous record peak.

Beyond the banking sector’s strength, securities leader Yuanta Financial (2885‑TW) also showed resilience today. Despite the market facing a thousand‑point pull‑back, Yuanta Financial was buoyed by buying interest, turning red on the day and hitting an intraday high of NT$72.8, up nearly 1%, creating a new record high and firmly securing its place in the “trillion‑dollar market‑cap club.”

Institutional investors point out that amid global market crashes and valuation corrections in high‑P/E electronics stocks, financial holding companies benefit from solid dividend yields and the interest‑income boost from rate hikes, making them a defensive favorite during market turbulence. However, investors should watch for prolonged high‑rate periods that could cause unrealized losses on banks’ foreign‑currency bond holdings and affect the overall quality of loan assets.

items.title: 台達電鄭平：三因素限制電力設施建置 供電缺口成AI發展關鍵挑戰
items.title_en: Delta Electronics' Zheng Ping: Three Factors Restrict Power Facility Construction, Power Supply Gap Becomes Key AI Development Challenge
paras: 台達電(2308-TW)董事長鄭平今(15)日表示，AI資料中心快速擴張，全球電力需求持續攀升，但電力基礎設施建置受到法規、設備使用年限及投資報酬率等因素限制，電力供應難以跟上AI產業的擴張速度，將成為AI發展的重要挑戰。
鄭平指出，AI帶動雲端服務供應商(CSP)資本支出快速成長，美國四大CSP近年資本支出預估將達2022年的4.7倍，但電力系統投資成長幅度僅約1.8倍。美國預估到2028年，新增資料中心用電需求將達44GW，但電網新增供電能力僅25GW，兩者相差19GW。
他表示，其他國家也面臨類似問題，部分地區已開始限制資料中心用電，或要求大型資料中心必須具備自有供電能力，顯示電力供應已成為AI基礎設施建置的重要課題。
除了AI資料中心，電氣化也將持續推升整體用電需求。鄭平表示，全球目前平均電氣化程度約21%，台灣約30%，而交通運輸、工業等領域仍有大量能源仰賴天然氣、煤炭及其他燃料。隨著電動車、資料中心及建築自動化等應用發展，預估未來10年電動車用電量將成長至目前的5倍，資料中心到2030年的用電量則可達去年的3倍左右。
鄭平指出，推動電氣化除了能擴大綠色電力的使用，也是能源轉型與減碳的重要方向，但在電力需求持續增加、供電建設又相對受限的情況下，如何確保電力供應穩定並提升能源使用效率，將是未來的重要挑戰。
針對這項需求，台達電已投入超過10年建構微電網相關解決方案。鄭平表示，大型AI資料中心不能只考量內部供電及散熱，還必須從整體電力系統著手，涵蓋發電、輸電、配電、儲能及用電管理，透過整合各環節提升能源使用效率。台達電過去主要著重於用電端，如今已逐步擴大至整體能源管理。
在產品方面，台達電推出固態氧化物燃料電池(SOFC)與固態變壓器(SST)。鄭平指出，SOFC可使用氫氣或天然氣發電，搭配能源回收後，整體能源利用效率可達85%，並可採分散式方式建置，預計明年量產。
至於SST，則可減少傳統資料中心供電架構中的多次電力轉換，並將電力轉換為800V直流電，提升整體能源轉換效率。鄭平表示，台達電也將SST整合為預製式系統，在工廠完成組裝後再運送至客戶端，以簡化現場建置流程。
paras_en: Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) Chairman Zheng Ping said on the 15th that the rapid expansion of AI data centers is driving a continuous rise in global electricity demand, but the construction of power infrastructure is constrained by regulations, equipment lifespan and investment return rates, making power supply unable to keep pace with AI industry growth and posing a major challenge for AI development.

Zheng noted that AI is spurring fast growth in capital expenditures by cloud service providers (CSPs). The four major U.S. CSPs are projected to increase capex to 4.7 times the 2022 level in recent years, while investment in power systems is expected to grow only about 1.8 times. The U.S. estimates that by 2028 new data‑center electricity demand will reach 44 GW, but the grid’s added supply capacity will be only 25 GW, leaving a 19 GW shortfall.

He added that other countries face similar issues; some regions have begun limiting data‑center electricity use or requiring large data centers to have their own power supply, underscoring that power supply has become a critical issue for AI infrastructure deployment.

Beyond AI data centers, electrification will continue to lift overall electricity demand. Zheng said the world’s average electrification level is about 21%, Taiwan’s about 30%, and sectors such as transportation and industry still rely heavily on natural gas, coal and other fuels. With the growth of electric vehicles, data centers and building automation, he estimates EV electricity consumption will rise to five times current levels within ten years, and data‑center consumption could reach roughly three times last year’s level by 2030.

Zheng pointed out that promoting electrification not only expands the use of green power but is also a key direction for energy transition and carbon reduction. However, with rising power demand and relatively limited supply construction, ensuring stable power supply and improving energy use efficiency will be a major future challenge.

In response to this need, Delta Electronics has invested more than ten years in developing micro‑grid solutions. Zheng said large AI data centers cannot focus solely on internal power and cooling; they must address the entire power system, covering generation, transmission, distribution, storage and load management, and improve energy efficiency through integrated solutions. Delta previously emphasized the consumption side but is now expanding to overall energy management.

On the product side, Delta introduced solid‑oxide fuel cells (SOFC) and solid‑state transformers (SST). Zheng explained that SOFCs can generate power from hydrogen or natural gas, achieving overall energy utilization efficiencies of up to 85% when combined with energy recovery, and can be deployed in a distributed manner, with mass production slated for next year.

Regarding SSTs, they can reduce multiple power conversions in traditional data‑center supply architectures and convert power to 800 V DC, boosting overall energy conversion efficiency. Zheng said Delta will also integrate SSTs into prefabricated systems that are assembled in factories and then shipped to customers, simplifying on‑site installation.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉台股重挫逾千點 電信三雄成資金避風港紛紛走揚
items.title_en: Focus Stocks: Taiwan Market Plunges Over 1,000 Points, Telecom Trio Becomes Safe‑Haven as All Rise
paras: 台股今(15)日狂瀉超過1700點，資金流往電信三雄避風頭，中華電信(2412-TW)、台灣大(3045-TW)以及遠傳(4904-TW)紛紛走揚，其中，中華電信及台灣大股價創高，遠傳則挑戰前高。
中華電信盤中最高漲至154元，漲逾3%，台灣大衝上133元，漲逾4%，雙雙創歷史新天價，遠傳最高則漲至113元，漲幅超過4%，挑戰前高113.5元，電信三雄成交皆爆量超過1萬張。
電信三雄電信本業同步受惠蘋果新機iPhone 18 Pro系列開賣，9月營收與獲利表現亮麗，其中，中華電信因資產活化效益發酵，認列相關營收，9月每股純益0.57元，續坐單月獲利王寶座，中華電信指出，資產活化策略將聚焦「以租代售」為核心，以利持續貢獻持續性收入。
電信三雄前三季財務表現皆亮眼，中華電信稅後純益329.7億元，年增12.1%，每股純益4.25元；台灣大稅後純益129.5億元，年增22.87%，每股純益4.26元；遠傳稅後純益113.92億元，年增13.24%，每股純益3.16元。台灣大與中華電信前三季每股純益僅差0.01元，台灣大則成為前三季獲利王。
paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market tumbled more than 1,700 points today (Oct. 15), with capital flowing into the three telecom giants as a safe haven. Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW), Taiwan Mobile (3045‑TW) and Far EasTone (4904‑TW) all rallied, with Chunghwa and Taiwan Mobile hitting record highs and Far EasTone testing its previous peak.

Chunghwa Telecom rose intraday to a high of NT$154, up over 3%, while Taiwan Mobile surged to NT$133, up more than 4%, both setting all‑time highs. Far EasTone peaked at NT$113, a gain of over 4%, challenging its prior high of NT$113.5. Trading volume for all three telecom stocks exploded, each exceeding 10,000 lots.

The telecoms’ core businesses are benefiting simultaneously from the launch of Apple’s new iPhone 18 Pro series, which boosted September revenue and profit. Chunghwa Telecom, in particular, saw the effects of its asset‑revitalisation strategy, recognizing related revenue and posting a September EPS of NT$0.57, keeping it atop the one‑month profit leaderboard. Chunghwa said the strategy will focus on a “lease‑instead‑of‑sale” model to sustain recurring income.

All three telecoms delivered strong financial results for the first three quarters. Chunghwa posted a post‑tax profit of NT$32.97 billion, up 12.1% year‑on‑year, with EPS of NT$4.25. Taiwan Mobile earned NT$12.95 billion, up 22.87% YoY, with EPS of NT$4.26. Far EasTone reported NT$11.392 billion in profit, up 13.24% YoY, with EPS of NT$3.16. Taiwan Mobile’s EPS was only NT$0.01 lower than Chunghwa’s, making Taiwan Mobile the profit leader for the first three quarters.

items.title: 傳字節跳動洽購聯發科AI晶片 有望成Google後第二家主要ASIC客戶
items.title_en: ByteDance in Talks to Purchase MediaTek AI Chips, Potentially Becoming Its Second Major ASIC Customer After Google
paras: 《彭博》週四 (15 日) 報導，TikTok母公司字節跳動與聯發科 (2454-TW) 的資料中心客製化晶片採購談判已進入深入階段，雙方接近達成協議。若交易敲定，字節跳動有望成為繼Google之後，聯發科第二家主要特殊應用積體電路 (ASIC) 客戶，為聯發科拓展資料中心業務增添動能。
知情人士透露，聯發科將供應依照字節跳動平台需求客製化設計的ASIC，支援其資料中心運作，但未透露供貨數量。
字節跳動未立即回應置評請求，聯發科則不予置評。
字節跳動正擴大硬體投資，押注人工智慧 (AI) 成為下一波成長引擎。
然而，與阿里巴巴 (BABA-US) 和騰訊 (0700-HK) 等中國同業一樣，字節跳動受美國出口管制限制，無法取得輝達 (NVDA-US) 等業者最先進的AI晶片，華為等中國供應商也無法滿足所有需求，促使其尋求其他供應來源。
報導指出，與晶片設計業者合作，是字節跳動探索的替代方案之一。依現行美國出口管制規定，只要相關AI運算能力未超過特定門檻，這類合作仍獲允許。
《彭博》先前曾報導，字節跳動今年稍早已與高通 (QCOM-US) 達成類似協議，採購數百萬顆AI晶片。
對聯發科而言，若能取得字節跳動的大規模訂單，將有助於業務多元化、降低對手機市場的依賴，並強化其在資料中心領域與高通、博通 (AVGO-US) 競爭的能力。科技大廠積極開發AI客製化晶片，也讓聯發科得以運用行動處理器設計經驗，擴大參與資料中心基礎建設商機。
聯發科預估，2026年相關AI晶片業務營收約達20億美元，並估計2027年客製化AI ASIC潛在市場規模可達700億至800億美元，以爭取10%至15%市占率為目標。
輝達8月底宣布，將認購聯發科35億美元可轉換公司債，並擴大雙方在AI領域的合作。隨著客製化晶片業務受到市場關注，據《彭博》報導，聯發科市值約2,100億美元，以市值計為僅次於台積電 (2330-TW、TSM-US) 的台灣第二大企業。
字節跳動的晶片需求，則來自持續擴大的AI基礎建設計畫。
《彭博》報導，該公司正考慮將今年資本支出提高至最多700億美元，超過去年的2倍，用於擴建資料中心及其他AI設施。若經濟與營運條件有利，2027年支出可能進一步增至1,000億美元。公司已於9月取得300億美元貸款，支應相關投資。
這波投資反映字節跳動正加快布局，力求鞏固在聊天機器人與AI影片等領域的早期優勢，並擴大海外影響力。旗下Seedance等主力模型，正面對阿里巴巴Happy Horse、快手 (1024-HK) 可靈AI及Google等對手的競爭。

paras_en: Bloomberg reported on Thursday (the 15th) that TikTok parent ByteDance and MediaTek (2454-TW) have entered deep negotiations over custom data‑center chips, with both sides close to reaching an agreement. If the deal closes, ByteDance could become MediaTek’s second major ASIC customer after Google, adding momentum to MediaTek’s data‑center business expansion.

Sources familiar with the matter said MediaTek will supply ASICs custom‑designed to ByteDance’s platform requirements to support its data‑center operations, though the supply volume was not disclosed.
ByteDance did not immediately respond to requests for comment, and MediaTek declined to comment.
ByteDance is expanding its hardware investments, betting that artificial intelligence will be the next growth engine.

However, like Chinese peers such as Alibaba (BABA-US) and Tencent (0700-HK), ByteDance is constrained by U.S. export controls and cannot obtain the most advanced AI chips from companies like Nvidia (NVDA-US); Chinese suppliers such as Huawei also cannot meet all its needs, prompting it to look for alternative sources.

The report noted that partnering with chip designers is one of ByteDance’s explored alternatives. Under current U.S. export rules, such collaborations are still permitted as long as the AI compute capability does not exceed a certain threshold.
Bloomberg previously reported that ByteDance earlier this year reached a similar agreement with Qualcomm (QCOM-US) to purchase millions of AI chips.

For MediaTek, securing a large‑scale order from ByteDance would help diversify its business, reduce reliance on the smartphone market, and strengthen its ability to compete with Qualcomm and Broadcom (AVGO-US) in the data‑center arena. The tech giant’s push into AI‑custom chips also lets MediaTek leverage its mobile processor design expertise to capture more data‑center infrastructure opportunities.

MediaTek estimates that revenue from related AI chips could reach about $2 billion in 2026, and it projects the potential market for custom AI ASICs to be $70‑80 billion in 2027, targeting a 10‑15% market share.

Nvidia announced at the end of August that it would purchase $3.5 billion of MediaTek convertible bonds and expand cooperation in AI. As custom‑chip business draws market attention, Bloomberg said MediaTek’s market value is roughly $210 billion, making it Taiwan’s second‑largest company by market cap after TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US).
ByteDance’s chip demand stems from its continuously expanding AI infrastructure plans.

Bloomberg reported the company is considering raising its capital expenditure this year to as much as $70 billion, double last year’s level, to expand data‑centers and other AI facilities. If economic and operational conditions are favorable, spending could rise to $100 billion in 2027. The firm secured a $30 billion loan in September to fund these investments.

The investment wave reflects ByteDance’s accelerated rollout to cement early advantages in chat‑bots and AI‑generated video, while expanding its overseas influence. Its flagship models such as Seedance face competition from Alibaba’s Happy Horse, Kuaishou (1024‑HK)’s Keling AI, Google and others.
