items.title: Arm敗訴僅賠高通2美元！數十億美元權利金豁免成決戰關鍵
items.title_en: Arm Loses Lawsuit but Pays Qualcomm Only $2! Billion‑Dollar Royalty Waiver Becomes Decisive Issue
paras: 美國德拉瓦州聯邦陪審團10月13日作出裁決，認定晶片技術供應商Arm違反與高通(QCOM-US)的許可協議，並故意干預高通(QCOM-US)與Meta Platforms(META-US)的商業關係。然而，陪審團僅判處Arm向高通支付2美元的名義損害賠償，使得雙方均從裁決中尋得「勝利」的依據。
這項象徵性賠償背後，真正左右未來格局的將是接下來即將裁定的五年權利金豁免問題，涉及金額可能高達數十億美元。
經過為期五天的審理，德拉瓦州陪審團認定Arm違反了其與高通長期有效的架構許可協議（ALA），具體表現為未能履行向高通提供晶片設計所需軟體修補程式和測試工具的義務。此外，陪審團還認定Arm故意且過失地干預了高通與Meta之間的商業關係。
高通此前指控稱，2024年公司與Meta的一筆晶片供應協議已接近達成，但Arm向《彭博社》洩露了高通違反許可協議的通知，導致Meta對高通的授權狀態產生疑慮，交易因此被推遲，協議價值縮水約1.7億美元。
然而，儘管兩項指控成立，陪審團對每項違規僅判處1美元賠償，合計2美元。此外，陪審團還在高通提出的另外五項違約指控中，作出了有利於Arm的認定。
高通僅獲得2美元的賠償金額看似荒誕，實則具有明確的法律意涵。名義損害（nominal damages）賠償的判處意味著陪審團認可了高通指控Arm存在法律上的過錯，但認為高通未能證明其遭受了可直接量化的經濟損失。
Arm的律師也表示，高通所謂的損害更多是推測性的，而非實質性的財務損失。
正因如此，雙方在裁決後都迅速發表聲明，各自宣示「勝利」。
高通的聲明強調：「我們感到欣慰，因為陪審團認定Arm違反了雙方長期有效的架構許可協議，未能兌現承諾，並故意採取行動擾亂高通的業務。」高通還表示，這一結果「進一步暴露了Arm損害高通及其生態系統的更廣泛意圖」。
Arm的回應同樣積極：「我們對陪審團的裁決感到滿意，該裁決在四項訴求上支持Arm，並就高通另外兩項訴求分別僅判賠1美元。」Arm強調，這一結果「印證了Arm在技術許可協議項下出於善意行事」。
五年權利金豁免懸而未決
本次法庭裁決的2美元賠償金本身無關痛癢，但其背後的違約認定卻為高通打開了通往更大法律利益的大門。
高通正在尋求依據許可協議中的一項條款，主張由於Arm違約，高通有權在五年內停止向Arm支付權利金。據《路透社》報導，這筆金額可能高達數十億美元。Arm則主張，該五年權利金罰則條款「無法強制執行」。
此爭議將由美國聯邦地區法官Maryellen Noreika裁決，而非陪審團。Noreika法官同時還需裁定另一項關鍵問題：Arm是否就下一代技術（ARMv10）與高通進行了善意協商。
庭審中披露的一個細節加劇了雙方在下一代技術定價上的對立：高通的律師引用圖表顯示，Arm尋求將其計算架構從第9版升級到第10版時，專利費提高1800%。而Arm的律師則反問高通執行長安蒙，2013年協議中每顆晶片1.88美元的專利費上限，在資料中心晶片擁有288個核心的2026年是否還合理。
可以說，Noreika法官後續關於五年權利金豁免的認定，將決定高通與Arm這場法律戰的實際經濟後果。無論結果如何，敗訴一方幾乎必然會提起上訴，這場橫跨數年的晶片巨頭法律戰遠未到終局。
paras_en: On October 13, a federal jury in Delaware ruled that chip‑technology supplier Arm violated its licensing agreement with Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) and deliberately interfered with Qualcomm’s business relationship with Meta Platforms (META‑US). However, the jury awarded only a nominal $2 in damages to Qualcomm, allowing both sides to claim a "victory" from the verdict.

Behind this symbolic award, the real determinant of the future landscape will be the upcoming decision on a five‑year royalty‑waiver issue that could involve amounts in the tens of billions of dollars.

After a five‑day trial, the Delaware jury found that Arm breached its long‑standing Architecture License Agreement (ALA) with Qualcomm by failing to provide the software patches and testing tools needed for chip design. The jury also concluded that Arm deliberately and negligently interfered with Qualcomm’s commercial relationship with Meta.

Qualcomm had previously alleged that a chip‑supply deal with Meta in 2024 was close to completion, but Arm leaked to Bloomberg that Qualcomm had violated the licensing agreement, causing Meta to doubt Qualcomm’s licensing status. The deal was delayed and its value shrank by about $170 million.

Nevertheless, although both allegations were upheld, the jury awarded only $1 in damages for each violation, totaling $2. In addition, the jury ruled in favor of Arm on five other breach claims raised by Qualcomm.

Qualcomm’s $2 award may seem absurd, but it carries a clear legal meaning. The nominal‑damages award indicates that the jury recognized Qualcomm’s claim that Arm committed a legal wrong, but found that Qualcomm failed to prove any directly quantifiable economic loss.
Arm’s lawyers also said that Qualcomm’s alleged damages are largely speculative rather than actual financial losses.
For that reason, both parties quickly issued statements after the verdict, each proclaiming a "victory."

Qualcomm’s statement emphasized: "We are pleased that the jury found Arm breached the long‑standing Architecture License Agreement, failed to fulfill its commitments, and deliberately acted to disrupt Qualcomm’s business." Qualcomm added that the result "further exposes Arm’s broader intent to harm Qualcomm and its ecosystem."

Arm’s response was equally upbeat: "We are satisfied with the jury’s decision, which supports Arm on four of the claims and awards only $1 for each of Qualcomm’s two remaining claims." Arm stressed that the outcome "confirms that Arm acted in good faith under the technology licensing agreement."
Five‑Year Royalty Waiver Still Unresolved
The $2 damages award itself is immaterial, but the breach findings open the door for Qualcomm to pursue much larger legal benefits.

Qualcomm is seeking to invoke a clause in the licensing agreement that, because of Arm’s breach, gives Qualcomm the right to stop paying royalties to Arm for five years. Reuters reports that the amount at stake could reach tens of billions of dollars. Arm argues that the five‑year royalty‑penalty clause "cannot be enforced."

The dispute will be decided by U.S. District Judge Maryellen Noreika, not the jury. Judge Noreika must also rule on another key issue: whether Arm engaged in good‑faith negotiations with Qualcomm over next‑generation technology (ARMv10).

A detail revealed during the trial heightened the pricing clash over next‑generation tech: Qualcomm’s lawyers presented a chart showing that when Arm sought to upgrade its compute architecture from version 9 to version 10, patent fees jumped 1,800%. Arm’s counsel retorted by asking Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon whether the 2013 agreement’s $1.88 per‑chip patent‑fee cap remains reasonable in 2026, when data‑center chips have 288 cores.

Judge Noreika’s forthcoming ruling on the five‑year royalty waiver will determine the actual economic outcome of the legal battle between Qualcomm and Arm. Regardless of the result, the losing party is almost certain to appeal, and this multi‑year chip‑giant lawsuit is far from over.

items.title: 一檔股票拖垮全球半導體？財經名嘴：美晶片股是看SK海力士臉色　不是輝達
items.title_en: One Stock Dragging Down Global Semiconductors? CNBC Host: US Chip Stocks Follow SK Hynix, Not Nvidia
paras: SK海力士正處於全球記憶體晶片拋售潮風暴中心，近六日ADR股價跌逾15%，今(15)日早盤在南韓市場崩逾10%，美光、西部數據、希捷週三(14日)跌近2%。對此《CNBC》名嘴Jim Cramer指出，SK海力士與SMH半導體ETF成分股高度連動，美股晶片族群更跟海力士連動，非只跟輝達，其記憶體業務規模與價格指標意義，令SK海力士成為更廣泛半導體賣壓的領頭羊。
晶片股拋售潮表面上是獲利了結，深層則在重估三件事：一是中國長鑫存儲推進4F²架構、預計今年底推出伺服器DDR5，通用DRAM與伺服器記憶體供給預期生變；二是AI資本支出回報受質疑，市場怕HBM漲價循環見頂；三是利率走高壓縮高成長股容錯空間。
Roundhill策略師Drew Pettit表示，記憶體類股經過獲利預期大幅上修後進入「轉型期」，投資人開始追問成長能否延續，任何負面消息都被放大。
不過，中國威脅目前有邊界。美國財富管理與投行D.A. Davidson董事總經理Gil Luria表示，長鑫存儲份額與技術確實提升，但主力仍在通用DRAM及中低端，HBM由SK海力士、三星主導，且難供應微軟、谷歌、亞馬遜、蘋果、輝達等美系大客戶。若僅計算通用記憶體價格壓力，SK海力士、三星受影響較大，美光相對免疫。
Luria也對半導體週期仍偏樂觀，理由是中國AI供應鏈業績、展望與能見度改善。
對SK海力士而言，短線要看中國擴產、外資賣超與HBM毛利可持續性；中長線仍看SK海力士在高堆疊HBM的領先地位與AI伺服器綁定。
Cramer建議別只盯短線，應回到AI系統與終端設備記憶體需求成長，但在估值已反映高預期下，任何量產遞延、客戶驗證或中國低價滲透消息，都可能繼續放大波動。
paras_en: SK Hynix is at the center of a global memory chip sell‑off storm, with its ADR falling more than 15% over the past six days and its South Korean market price plunging over 10% in early trading today (the 15th). Micron, Western Digital and Seagate each slipped about 2% on Wednesday (the 14th). CNBC host Jim Cramer noted that SK Hynix is highly correlated with the SMH semiconductor ETF, and that U.S. chip stocks are moving in tandem with Hynix—not just Nvidia—because its memory business size and pricing benchmarks make SK Hynix the leading driver of broader semiconductor selling pressure.

The chip‑stock sell‑off looks on the surface like profit‑taking, but deeper it reflects a re‑evaluation of three factors: first, China’s ChangXin Memory is advancing its 4F² architecture and expects to launch server DDR5 by year‑end, potentially reshaping supply of commodity DRAM and server memory; second, the return on AI capital expenditures is being questioned, with the market fearing that the HBM price‑rise cycle may have peaked; third, rising interest rates are compressing the margin for error in high‑growth stocks.

Roundhill strategist Drew Pettit said memory stocks have entered a "transformation phase" after profit expectations were sharply upgraded, and investors are now probing whether growth can be sustained, so any negative news gets amplified.

However, the Chinese threat has limits. Gil Luria, managing director at U.S. wealth‑management and investment‑banking firm D.A. Davidson, said ChangXin’s market share and technology are indeed improving, but its focus remains on commodity DRAM and mid‑to‑low‑end segments. HBM is dominated by SK Hynix and Samsung and is difficult to supply to major U.S. customers such as Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Apple and Nvidia. If you look only at pressure on commodity memory prices, SK Hynix and Samsung are more affected, while Micron is relatively insulated.
Luria also remains somewhat optimistic about the semiconductor cycle, citing improving performance, outlook and visibility for China’s AI supply chain.

For SK Hynix, the short‑term outlook hinges on Chinese capacity expansion, foreign‑investor net selling, and the sustainability of HBM margins; the medium‑to‑long term still depends on SK Hynix’s leading position in high‑stack HBM and its tie‑in with AI servers.

Cramer advises not to focus solely on the short term but to return to the growth in memory demand from AI systems and end‑device equipment. Yet, with valuations already reflecting lofty expectations, any delays in mass production, customer validation issues, or news of low‑price penetration from China could continue to magnify volatility.

items.title: 波克夏加碼3.3億美元入股 Bending Spoons暴漲超40%
items.title_en: Berkshire Adds $330 Million Stake in Bending Spoons, Shares Surge Over 40%
paras: 多家外媒報導，義大利軟體收購業者 Bending Spoons (BSP-US) 獲波克夏·海瑟威 (BRK.B-US) 追加投資3.3億美元，帶動股價週三 (14日) 飆漲逾40%。然而，這家公司的估值並不便宜，也讓向來重視價值的波克夏為何出手，成為市場關注焦點。
根據證券申報文件，Bending Spoons 將以每股33美元，向波克夏發行1,000萬股普通股，交易完成後，波克夏持股比重將達4%。此次募得資金將提高公司推動收購的財務彈性。
這是波克夏今年第二度投資 Bending Spoons。今年7月，該公司於那斯達克首次公開發行股票 (IPO) 時，波克夏已投入6億美元，加計此次追加投資，累計投入達9.3億美元。隨著股價大漲，波克夏這筆持股的帳面獲利估計已達約6億美元。
不過，依週三公告揭露的股數推算，Bending Spoons 市值約400億美元，IPO時另有約40億美元債務。若以股權市值加計債務的企業價值衡量，估值接近預估年營收的10倍；以2027年預估獲利計算，本益比則約30倍。
這樣的買進估值，與波克夏過往部分大型投資形成鮮明對比。巴菲特 (Warren Buffett) 師承價值投資大師葛拉漢，長期重視買進價格與企業價值之間的關係。即使是波克夏最成功的股票投資之一、目前最大持股蘋果 (AAPL-US)，在2016年至2018年大舉買進時，本益比也不到15倍。
Bending Spoons 主要透過收購軟體及訂閱制應用程式拓展事業版圖。共同創辦人暨企業收購主管 Francesco Patarnello 表示，公司持續評估併購機會，目前潛在交易案源仍相當充足。
Patarnello 認為，波克夏追加投資反映其對公司團隊與營運平台的信心，也將強化財務調度能力，協助公司配合整體融資策略，把握具吸引力的收購機會。
支持者則看好 Bending Spoons 收購後的整合與經營能力。Durable Capital Partners 創辦人暨投資長 Henry Ellenbogen 今年7月表示，看好該公司每名員工創造的營收及稅息折舊攤銷前獲利 (EBITDA) 持續提升，進而推動內生成長，並讓營收擴張帶來更大幅度的獲利成長。
從波克夏整體布局來看，這家投資集團近一年也增加了科技股投資，目前持有逾1億股 Alphabet (GOOGL-US)，其中包括今年6月以每股不到350美元、斥資100億美元買進的部位。
不過，Alphabet 的買進由巴菲特主導，Bending Spoons 這筆投資究竟由誰拍板，目前仍不清楚。
阿貝爾 (Greg Abel) 今年初接替巴菲特出任波克夏執行長，目前負責監督約3,500億美元的股票投資組合。投資經理魏許勒 (Ted Weschler) 管理其中約6%，巴菲特也仍參與投資決策。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported that Italian software‑acquisition firm Bending Spoons (BSP‑US) received an additional $330 million investment from Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B‑US), sending its stock up more than 40% on Wednesday (the 14th). The company’s valuation is far from cheap, prompting market observers to wonder why value‑focused Berkshire would step in.

According to securities filing documents, Bending Spoons will issue 10 million common shares to Berkshire at $33 per share, giving Berkshire a 4% ownership stake after the transaction. The capital raised will increase the company’s financial flexibility for future acquisitions.

This is Berkshire’s second investment in Bending Spoons this year. When the company went public on Nasdaq in July, Berkshire had already put $600 million into it; with the new infusion, total investment reaches $930 million. The share price jump means Berkshire’s paper profit on the holding is now roughly $600 million.

Based on the share count disclosed on Wednesday, Bending Spoons is valued at about $40 billion, with roughly $4 billion of debt at IPO. Measured by equity market cap plus debt (enterprise value), the valuation is close to ten times projected 2027 revenue; using projected 2027 earnings, the price‑to‑earnings multiple is about 30×.

Such a purchase price contrasts sharply with many of Berkshire’s past large‑cap bets. Warren Buffett, a disciple of value‑investing guru Graham, has long emphasized the relationship between purchase price and intrinsic value. Even Berkshire’s most successful equity holding, Apple (AAPL‑US), was bought at a P/E below 15× during the massive 2016‑2018 buying spree.

Bending Spoons expands its business mainly through acquiring software and subscription‑based apps. Co‑founder and corporate‑development head Francesco Patarnello said the company continues to evaluate acquisition opportunities and that the pipeline of potential deals remains robust.

Patarnello believes Berkshire’s follow‑on investment reflects confidence in the team and operating platform, and will strengthen financial flexibility, helping the company execute its broader financing strategy and seize attractive acquisition targets.

Supporters are optimistic about Bending Spoons’ post‑acquisition integration and operating capabilities. Henry Ellenbogen, founder and CIO of Durable Capital Partners, said in July he is bullish on the firm’s per‑employee revenue and EBITDA growth, which should drive organic expansion and translate revenue growth into outsized profit gains.

Looking at Berkshire’s overall positioning, the conglomerate has increased its tech‑stock exposure over the past year, now holding more than 100 million shares of Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), including a $10 billion purchase in June at just under $350 per share.
However, the Alphabet purchase was led by Buffett himself, and it remains unclear who approved the Bending Spoons investment.

Greg Abel took over from Buffett as Berkshire’s CEO earlier this year and now oversees roughly $350 billion of equity holdings. Investment manager Ted Weschler runs about 6% of that portfolio, while Buffett still participates in investment decisions.

items.title: CoreWeave擴張AI轉向保險業尋資金 創辦人：必須成為巨頭
items.title_en: CoreWeave Expands AI Push into Insurance Funding; Founder Says It Must Become a Giant
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，由輝達(NVDA-US)支持的CoreWeave(CRWV-US)，正尋求引入保險業資金，因為 AI 基礎建設的擴張日益仰賴債務融資。
CoreWeave 共同創辦人 Brannin McBee 在週三(14日)刊出的《金融時報》專訪中表示，公司正尋求取得保險公司的龐大投資資金，以爭取成本可能更低的融資。McBee 表示，若能取得更高的投資等級信用評等，將有助於公司向保險公司借款，而這些機構的資金「是無限的」。
公司也正在評估，保險公司是否能購買由信用評等較低的客戶所提供擔保的貸款，其中包括 AI 研究實驗室。McBee 表示，這類交易目前尚未準備好推向保險市場。
CoreWeave 正評估增加可延後動用的定期貸款，以加快資料中心建設及設備採購。McBee 將這種做法比擬為透過預先出售合約，為發電廠融資。
他表示，未來 AI 研究實驗室若上市，可能改善這些公司的信用狀況；與此同時，CoreWeave 仍以躋身業界最大型基礎建設供應商之列為目標。
McBee 表示：「如果我們今天停止建設，就會有極為龐大的正向現金流。」但他也指出：「我們正處於一個必須做得夠大的時期。你必須成為規模最大的業者之一。」
CoreWeave 的融資策略出爐之際，科技與金融業的高階主管紛紛警告，資金可取得性可能成為限制 AI 基礎建設成長的一大因素。
AI熱潮面臨融資風險 成本持續攀升
共同創辦人 McBee 發表上述言論之際，投資人 Chamath Palihapitiya 正質疑 AI 熱潮是否正在助長私人信貸泡沫。此前，CoreWeave 2032 年到期債券的殖利率一度升至 15%，最後以創紀錄的 14.5% 收盤。
Palihapitiya 強調，市場對債務、租賃及其他融資方式的依賴日益增加。美國直接放款市場規模已從 2010 年的 960 億美元，激增至 2025 年的 2.4 兆美元。2025 年直接貸款市場中，科技企業占 1.05 兆美元，占比達 44%；其中，提供給 AI、大數據及雲端公司的貸款超過 2,000 億美元。
高盛執行長蘇德巍(David Solomon)週二表示，AI 運算需求持續超越供給，但他警告，龐大的融資需求可能推高借貸成本，並威脅部分專案的可行性。他指出，利率上升可能壓縮投資報酬，使部分專案更難取得融資。
不過，Solomon 也表示，運算能力需求持續超越供給，將支持更多建設與融資活動。
本週稍早，博通(AVGO-US)執行長陳福陽警告，取得資金可能比晶片或電力短缺更容易成為 AI 基礎建設擴張的瓶頸。他指出，運算需求可能持續超越供給，直到 2029 年或 2030 年。
英特爾(INTC-US)執行長陳立武則對高昂的借貸成本，以及 AI 投資能否帶來足夠報酬以證明相關支出合理，表達擔憂。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that CoreWeave (CRWV-US), backed by Nvidia (NVDA-US), is seeking to bring insurance‑industry capital into its AI infrastructure expansion, which is increasingly reliant on debt financing.

CoreWeave co‑founder Brannin McBee told the Financial Times on Wednesday (the 14th) that the company is looking for large investments from insurers to secure potentially cheaper financing. McBee said that a higher investment‑grade credit rating would help the firm borrow from insurers, whose capital “is limitless.”

The firm is also evaluating whether insurers could purchase loans backed by lower‑rated borrowers, including AI research labs. McBee noted that such transactions are not yet ready for the insurance market.

CoreWeave is assessing the addition of longer‑term, delayed‑draw term loans to accelerate data‑center construction and equipment purchases. McBee likened the approach to financing a power plant by pre‑selling contracts.

He added that if AI research labs eventually go public, it could improve those companies’ credit profiles; meanwhile CoreWeave still aims to become one of the largest infrastructure providers in the industry.
McBee said, “If we stop building today, we would have an enormous positive cash flow.” He also warned, “We are at a point where we have to be big enough. You have to be one of the biggest players.”
As CoreWeave’s financing strategy emerges, senior executives in tech and finance are warning that the availability of capital could become a major constraint on AI infrastructure growth.
AI hype faces financing risk as costs keep climbing

When co‑founder McBee made those remarks, investor Chamath Palihapitiya questioned whether the AI boom is fueling a private‑credit bubble. Earlier, CoreWeave’s 2032 bond yield had spiked to 15% before closing at a record 14.5%.

Palihapitiya stressed that reliance on debt, leasing and other financing is growing. The U.S. direct‑lending market has surged from $96 billion in 2010 to $2.4 trillion projected for 2025. In 2025, tech firms will account for $1.05 trillion (44%) of that market, with loans to AI, big‑data and cloud companies exceeding $200 billion.

Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon said on Tuesday that AI compute demand continues to outpace supply, but warned that massive financing needs could push borrowing costs higher and threaten the viability of some projects. He noted that rising rates could compress investment returns, making financing harder to obtain for certain projects.
Nevertheless, Solomon added that the ongoing gap between compute demand and supply will continue to drive construction and financing activity.

Earlier this week, Broadcom (AVGO-US) CEO Hock Tan warned that securing funding could become a bigger bottleneck for AI infrastructure expansion than chip or power shortages. He said compute demand may stay ahead of supply through 2029 or 2030.
Intel (INTC-US) CEO Pat Gelsinger expressed concern about the high cost of borrowing and whether AI investments can generate enough returns to justify the spending.

items.title: 蘋果摺疊機搶攻中國市場 阿里模型獲准導入iPhone
items.title_en: Apple's Foldable Phone Targets Chinese Market as Alibaba Models Approved for iPhone
paras: 蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 傳出將於12月透過 iOS 27.3 更新，在中國大陸正式推出人工智慧平台 Apple Intelligence，為這項因監管審批延宕近兩年的服務開啟新進展。不過，首波版本預計仍有明顯功能限制，不會搭載新版 Siri AI 助理，部分影像生成與文字生成功能也可能缺席。與此同時，中國主管機關已核准阿里巴巴 (Alibaba Group Holding) (BABA-US) 旗下通義千問 (Qwen) 及通義萬相 AI 模型供多款蘋果手機使用，涵蓋即將上市的首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo、iPhone 18 Pro 及部分舊款機型，為蘋果在中國市場部署 AI 功能排除重要監管障礙。

中國核准阿里 AI 模型　蘋果服務上線再進一步

《彭博》10月14日引述知情人士報導，蘋果計畫在12月隨 iOS 27.3 更新推出中國版 Apple Intelligence。這項計畫籌備多年，原先預定於2025年5月推出，之後延至2025年底，再延後至2026年春季，主要受到中國政府審批進度影響。蘋果今年7月已取得初步許可，近期又與中國工業和信息化部進一步溝通，為服務正式面向消費者推出爭取核准。

中國監管進展也反映在手機許可文件上。《南華早報》10月14日報導，中國工業和信息化部更新 iPhone Duo、iPhone 18 Pro 及多款舊機型的網路接入許可，列入三項 AI 系統，分別是 Apple Intelligence、阿里巴巴旗下通義千問，以及專注文字生成圖像與影片的通義萬相。通義千問由阿里雲開發，是一系列大型語言模型；通義萬相則提供 AI 影像與影片生成能力。相關文件為蘋果 AI 服務在中國推出提供更明確的監管進展，也讓即將上市的新機與 AI 功能的關係受到關注。

不過，初步許可、模型使用核准及服務正式上市，並非完全相同的程序。《南華早報》指出，蘋果7月已獲准在中國大陸推出 Apple Intelligence，但服務當時仍未上線；《彭博》則稱，蘋果在9月29日取得近期機型使用 Apple Intelligence 及阿里 AI 模型的相關許可，之後仍須就面向消費者的正式推出與主管機關進一步溝通。不同報導對核准程序的描述略有差異，但共同指向同一進展，即蘋果正逐步完成中國市場部署 AI 服務所需的監管程序。

阿里巴巴、百度分工　中國版 AI 須符合監管要求

為符合中國對生成式人工智慧的監管要求，蘋果必須採取與其他市場不同的合作模式。《彭博》指出，中國版 Apple Intelligence 的內容防護機制將由阿里巴巴協助開發，其中包括讓中國政府能夠審核 AI 模型後續更新的過濾機制。這意味著服務推出後，模型更新與功能擴展仍可能受到監管流程影響，蘋果無法完全依照其他市場的產品更新節奏推進。

除了阿里巴巴，百度 (Baidu) (BIDU-US) 也是蘋果在中國 AI 布局的重要合作夥伴。百度參與搜尋及 Siri 相關功能的開發，協助蘋果在中國市場提供符合當地規範的服務。由於中國對外國 AI 技術及生成式 AI 服務設有監管限制，蘋果必須借助當地業者的模型與技術能力，才能逐步推進 Apple Intelligence。這也使中國版服務的技術架構、內容管理與功能安排，與蘋果在其他市場採用的模式有所不同。

首波功能有所限制　新版 Siri 與影像生成工具暫缺席

中國版 Apple Intelligence 初期預計將開放部分既有功能，包括 Genmoji 自訂表情符號、AI 通知摘要、寫作工具，以及照片 App 的「清除」功能，讓使用者移除照片中的不需要物件。不過，《彭博》報導指出，首波版本不會包含新版 Siri AI 助理，也不會提供蘋果自家的影像生成工具 Image Playground，部分 App 內的文字生成能力也將受到限制。這代表中國用戶雖有機會在12月開始使用部分 AI 工具，實際體驗仍不會與其他市場完全一致。
其中，Siri AI 是蘋果近年 AI 升級的重要部分，涉及更進階的語意理解、個人情境掌握及跨應用程式操作。若中國版服務無法同步提供新版 Siri，蘋果便難以在初期完整展示其 AI 生態系的功能。即使通知摘要、寫作輔助及照片編輯等工具陸續上線，蘋果仍須透過後續更新補足功能差距，而更新時程又可能受到中國監管要求影響。

iPhone Duo 下週預購　新機上市時能用哪些 AI 仍待確認

iPhone Duo 的上市時程，則讓這項 AI 進展格外受到關注。《Computerworld》指出，iPhone Duo 預計10月16日在包括中國在內約70個市場開放預購，並於10月23日開始出貨。這款蘋果首款摺疊手機，將與 iPhone 18 Pro 等機型一同成為蘋果今年高階產品布局的重要部分。中國也是全球摺疊手機的重要市場，市場競爭者包括華為等本土品牌，因此阿里巴巴模型取得核准，被視為蘋果在新機上市前改善 AI 服務布局的重要一步。

然而，各家媒體對 iPhone Duo 在中國上市時能否直接使用阿里 AI 功能，說法並不一致。《Semafor》報導稱，iPhone Duo 下週在中國上市時將搭載阿里巴巴 AI；《Engadget》則將阿里模型獲准與新機上市連結，指出相關進展有助於 Apple Intelligence 登場。但《彭博》對12月正式推出時程的報導指出，首波版本不包含新版 Siri AI 及今年公布的部分新功能。由於蘋果尚未公開說明中國版 Apple Intelligence 的確切功能表與啟用日期，目前仍無法確認 iPhone Duo 上市首日可使用哪些 AI 功能，也不能將新機搭載阿里模型的說法，直接等同於完整 Apple Intelligence 已同步開放。

中國手機品牌積極導入 AI　蘋果面臨追趕壓力

蘋果在中國推出 AI 服務的延宕，已使其在智慧手機 AI 功能競爭上承受壓力。華為、小米、OPPO、vivo 等中國品牌，已陸續將 AI 助理、文字生成、影像編輯及其他智慧功能整合至手機產品。對蘋果而言，AI 不只是軟體功能升級，也關係到高階手機的產品差異化與消費者換機意願。《Semafor》指出，蘋果將 AI 視為與華為競爭的重要環節；中國新創 AI 公司 StepFun 本週二也推出售價600美元的 AI 代理手機，顯示當地業者正積極將 AI 能力延伸至手機硬體與代理式服務。

市場數據則呈現不同觀察角度。《Computerworld》引述 Counterpoint Research 數據指出，蘋果在9月14日至20日當週占中國智慧手機市場約33%；另有中國當地報導稱，新機首週銷量達130萬部，但這項數字並非蘋果正式公布的銷售數據。摩根大通 (JPMorgan Chase) (JPM-US) 則表示，iPhone 18 Pro 在中國的需求高於前一代 iPhone 17 Pro。

不過，若從整季出貨量觀察，市場表現並非全面強勁。根據 IDC 的資料，2026年第三季中國智慧手機出貨量年減15.4%至5,790萬支，已連續第六季下滑。華為出貨量約1,220萬支，市占率約21%；蘋果市占率約17.8%, 出貨量年減4.3%。OPPO、vivo 與小米出貨量也分別下滑17.6%、24.9%及20.4%。不同期間與統計方式的市占數據不能直接比較，但整體市場疲弱，意味著蘋果仍須在價格、硬體創新與 AI 體驗之間找到新的成長動能。

區域化 AI 布局成形　後續更新與功能完整度是關鍵

中國市場的特殊性，也使蘋果無法直接複製其他地區的 AI 推出策略。在美國及其他市場，蘋果與 Google (Alphabet) (GOOGL-US) 及 OpenAI 等業者合作，支援部分 Apple Intelligence 功能與較複雜的 AI 任務；中國市場則必須依照當地法規與技術環境，採用阿里巴巴及百度等本土合作夥伴的模型與服務。這種區域化策略雖有助符合監管要求，卻也增加技術整合與產品管理的複雜度，並可能造成各地使用者可用功能不一致。

對蘋果而言，取得核准只是第一步，接下來的關鍵是能否把監管進展轉化為穩定、可持續更新的產品體驗。中國政府對模型後續更新保有審核權，可能影響功能擴充速度；而12月預計推出的版本又與 iPhone Duo 的上市時程錯開，使新機初期的 AI 體驗仍存在不確定性。若新版 Siri AI、Image Playground 及更多文字生成工具無法及時推出，Apple Intelligence 對高階 iPhone 的差異化效果可能受到限制。

整體而言，阿里巴巴通義千問與通義萬相取得核准，為蘋果在中國部署 Apple Intelligence 跨出重要一步，也顯示蘋果正透過本土合作夥伴回應中國的 AI 監管要求。但中國版服務能否如期於12月推出、iPhone Duo 上市時實際開放哪些功能，以及後續模型更新能否順利通過審核，仍是尚待釐清的問題。在中國智慧手機市場需求疲弱、本土品牌積極擴大 AI 布局的情況下，蘋果能否藉由有限度的 AI 功能重拾競爭優勢，將取決於正式推出後的功能完整度、更新速度及消費者接受程度。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is rumored to roll out its AI platform Apple Intelligence in mainland China via the iOS 27.3 update in December, marking a new development for a service that has been delayed by regulatory approval for nearly two years. However, the first version is expected to have clear functional limits, will not include the new Siri AI assistant, and some image‑generation and text‑generation features may be absent. At the same time, Chinese regulators have approved Alibaba Group Holding’s (BABA-US) Qwen and Tongyi Wanxiang AI models for use on several Apple phones, covering the upcoming first foldable iPhone Duo, the iPhone 18 Pro and some older models, removing a key regulatory hurdle for Apple’s AI rollout in China.

Bloomberg cited sources on October 14 saying Apple plans to launch a China‑specific Apple Intelligence with the iOS 27.3 update in December. The project, prepared for years, was originally slated for May 2025, then pushed to the end of 2025, and later to spring 2026, mainly due to Chinese government approval timelines. Apple secured a preliminary permit in July and has recently been in further talks with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology to obtain clearance for a consumer‑facing launch.

Regulatory progress is also reflected in phone approval documents. The South China Morning Post reported on October 14 that the Ministry updated network access permits for the iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro and several older models, listing three AI systems: Apple Intelligence, Alibaba’s Qwen, and the text‑to‑image/video model Tongyi Wanxiang. Qwen, developed by Alibaba Cloud, is a family of large language models; Wanxiang provides AI‑generated images and videos. The documents give clearer regulatory guidance for Apple’s AI services in China and draw attention to how the new devices will integrate AI features.

However, a preliminary permit, model‑use approval and the official service launch are not the same process. The South China Morning Post noted that Apple received permission in July to offer Apple Intelligence in mainland China, but the service was not yet live. Bloomberg said Apple obtained permission on September 29 to use Apple Intelligence and Alibaba AI models on recent devices, but still needs further talks with regulators before a consumer rollout. The differing reports describe the same overall progress: Apple is gradually completing the regulatory steps needed to deploy AI services in the Chinese market.

To meet China’s generative‑AI regulations, Apple must adopt a cooperation model different from other markets. Bloomberg reported that the content‑safeguard mechanism for the China‑specific Apple Intelligence will be co‑developed with Alibaba, including a filtering system that lets the Chinese government review subsequent model updates. This means that after launch, model updates and feature expansions could still be subject to regulatory review, preventing Apple from following the same product‑update cadence it uses elsewhere.

In addition to Alibaba, Baidu (BIDU-US) is another key AI partner for Apple in China. Baidu helps develop search‑related and Siri‑related functions, enabling Apple to deliver services that comply with local rules. Because China imposes regulatory limits on foreign AI technology and generative‑AI services, Apple must rely on domestic partners’ models and technical capabilities to advance Apple Intelligence, resulting in a technical architecture, content‑management and feature plan that differs from Apple’s approach in other regions.

The first wave of features will be limited. The China‑specific Apple Intelligence is expected to initially offer a subset of existing tools such as Genmoji custom emojis, AI notification summaries, writing assistance, and the Photos app’s “Remove” function for deleting unwanted objects. Bloomberg noted that the first version will not include the new Siri AI assistant, Apple’s own Image Playground image‑generation tool, and will restrict some in‑app text‑generation capabilities. Chinese users will therefore get some AI tools from December, but the experience will not match that of other markets.

Siri AI has been a major part of Apple’s recent AI upgrades, involving advanced semantic understanding, personal context awareness and cross‑app actions. Without the new Siri in the China version, Apple will struggle to showcase its full AI ecosystem early on. Even as notification summaries, writing aids and photo‑editing tools roll out, Apple will need later updates to fill the functional gap, and those updates could be delayed by Chinese regulatory requirements.

The iPhone Duo’s launch timeline puts the AI rollout under a spotlight. Computerworld reported that pre‑orders for the iPhone Duo begin on October 16 in about 70 markets, including China, with shipments starting on October 23. The foldable, Apple’s first, will sit alongside the iPhone 18 Pro as a key part of its high‑end lineup this year. China is a crucial market for foldables, competing with local brands such as Huawei, so the approval of Alibaba’s models is seen as an important step for Apple to improve its AI service offering before the new device’s launch.

Media reports differ on whether the iPhone Duo will be able to use Alibaba’s AI functions at launch in China. Semafor said the device will ship with Alibaba AI, while Engadget linked the model approval to the new phone’s debut, noting the progress helps Apple Intelligence arrive. Bloomberg, however, emphasized that the December launch will not include the new Siri AI or several of the newly announced features. Because Apple has not disclosed the exact feature set or activation date for the China version, it remains unclear which AI capabilities will be available on the Duo’s first day, and the claim that the phone will carry Alibaba’s models cannot be equated with a fully synchronized Apple Intelligence rollout.

Apple’s delayed AI service launch in China has increased pressure in the smartphone AI race. Domestic brands such as Huawei, Xiaomi, OPPO and vivo have already integrated AI assistants, text generation, image editing and other smart features into their phones. For Apple, AI is not just a software upgrade but also a differentiator for premium devices and a factor in consumer upgrade decisions. Semafor noted that Apple views AI as a key battleground against Huawei; Chinese AI startup StepFun also launched a $600 AI‑agent phone this week, showing local firms are actively extending AI capabilities to hardware and agent‑based services.

Market data offers mixed signals. Computerworld cited Counterpoint Research, which said Apple held roughly 33 % of the Chinese smartphone market in the week of September 14‑20. A local report claimed the new device sold 1.3 million units in its first week, though Apple has not officially confirmed that figure. JPMorgan Chase said demand for the iPhone 18 Pro in China exceeds that for the prior‑generation iPhone 17 Pro.

However, looking at quarterly shipments paints a less rosy picture. IDC data shows Chinese smartphone shipments fell 15.4 % year‑on‑year to 57.9 million units in Q3 2026, marking the sixth consecutive quarter of decline. Huawei shipped about 12.2 million units (≈21 % share), Apple’s share was about 17.8 % with shipments down 4.3 %, while OPPO, vivo and Xiaomi saw declines of 17.6 %, 24.9 % and 20.4 % respectively. Different time frames and measurement methods make direct comparison difficult, but the overall market weakness means Apple must find new growth engines across pricing, hardware innovation and AI experience.

Regionalized AI deployment is now taking shape, and future updates and feature completeness will be decisive. Because of China’s unique environment, Apple cannot simply copy its AI launch strategy from the U.S. and other regions. In the U.S., Apple works with Google (Alphabet) (GOOGL-US) and OpenAI to support certain Apple Intelligence functions and more complex AI tasks; in China, it must rely on local partners such as Alibaba and Baidu to meet regulatory and technical conditions. This localized approach helps satisfy regulators but adds integration and product‑management complexity, potentially leading to inconsistent feature availability across markets.

For Apple, gaining approval is only the first step; the real challenge is turning regulatory progress into a stable, continuously updated product experience. The Chinese government retains the right to review model updates, which could slow feature expansion, and the December release will miss the iPhone Duo’s launch window, leaving the new phone’s early AI experience uncertain. If the new Siri AI, Image Playground and additional text‑generation tools are not delivered promptly, Apple Intelligence’s differentiating impact on high‑end iPhones could be limited.

Overall, the approval of Alibaba’s Qwen and Tongyi Wanxiang models marks a significant milestone for Apple’s Apple Intelligence rollout in China and shows Apple is leveraging local partners to meet Chinese AI regulations. Yet questions remain about whether the China version will launch on schedule in December, which AI functions will be live when the iPhone Duo ships, and whether future model updates will clear regulatory review. In a slowing Chinese smartphone market where local brands are aggressively expanding AI capabilities, Apple’s ability to regain a competitive edge with limited AI features will depend on post‑launch feature completeness, update speed and consumer acceptance.

items.title: 標準版iPhone 18傳11月底投產 備貨量相當龐大
items.title_en: Standard iPhone 18 Said to Begin Mass Production at End of November with Huge Stockpiles
paras: 《AppleInsider》週三 (14 日) 報導，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 標準版 iPhone 18 傳將於 11 月啟動大規模量產，為預期於 2027 年春季上市預作準備。爆料者稱，相關零組件備貨量相當龐大，但未透露具體數字。
蘋果今年採取分批推出新款 iPhone 的策略，標準版 iPhone 18 預計於明年春季登場。中國微博爆料者「定焦數碼」近日表示，這款機型已排定生產，從庫存情況來看，備貨規模龐大。
不過，這項消息大致符合外界預期的上市時程。
若要在明年春季開賣，蘋果必須提前數月展開生產，因此，11 月啟動量產並準備大量零組件，屬於合理安排。
過去新款 iPhone 上市後，從首賣到耶誕節期間，通常以 Pro 與 Pro Max 機型的銷售表現較為強勁；到了隔年 2 月前後，標準版則逐漸成為銷售主力。
今年分批上市後，部分原本打算購買標準版的消費者，可能已轉而選購 iPhone 18 Pro。
不過，《AppleInsider》認為，這類買家的占比可能有限，蘋果仍可依據接近 iPhone 17 的需求規模，規劃標準版 iPhone 18 的產量。
考量標準版 iPhone 本身的銷售規模，供應鏈大量備料並不令人意外。
這次爆料主要顯示新機生產準備可能仍按預定時程推進，尚不足以據此判斷需求高於預期。
至於爆料可信度，《AppleInsider》提醒，「定焦數碼」過往消息有準有誤，但先前曾準確否認 iPhone Duo 延後推出的傳聞。
關於標準版 iPhone 18 規格，截至目前，外界傳 iPhone 18 將維持 6.3 吋螢幕，搭載採台積電 2 奈米製程打造的 A20 晶片，並可能導入蘋果自研 C2 數據機。
記憶體容量仍有不同說法，分析師郭明錤預測為 9GB，科技產業分析師 Jeff Pu 則預期升至 12GB。
此外，前置相機傳可能升級至 2,400 萬畫素，相機控制按鈕也可能簡化設計，但上述規格均尚未獲蘋果證實。
paras_en: AppleInsider reported on Wednesday (the 14th) that Apple (AAPL-US)’s standard iPhone 18 is rumored to start large‑scale production in November, in preparation for a planned spring 2027 launch. The leaker said component stockpiles are massive, but gave no specific figures.

Apple is using a staggered rollout strategy for new iPhone models this year, with the standard iPhone 18 expected to appear in spring next year. Chinese Weibo leaker “Dingjiao Digital” recently said the model has been scheduled for production and, judging by inventory levels, the stockpile is huge.
However, this news roughly matches the market’s expected launch timeline.

To sell the phone in spring next year, Apple must begin production several months in advance, so starting mass production in November and preparing large quantities of components is a reasonable plan.

Historically, after a new iPhone launches, sales of the Pro and Pro Max models are strongest from the initial release through the Christmas period; the standard model typically becomes the sales driver around February of the following year.
After this year’s staggered launch, some consumers who originally planned to buy the standard model may have switched to the iPhone 18 Pro.
AppleInsider believes that such buyers likely represent a limited share, and Apple can still plan the standard iPhone 18’s output based on demand levels similar to those for the iPhone 17.
Given the sales volume of the standard iPhone, a large supply‑chain stockpile is not surprising.
The leak mainly shows that production preparation appears to be proceeding on schedule, which is insufficient to conclude that demand exceeds expectations.
Regarding the leak’s credibility, AppleInsider notes that “Dingjiao Digital” has been both accurate and inaccurate in the past, but previously correctly denied rumors of an iPhone Duo delay.
As for the standard iPhone 18’s specifications, reports say it will retain a 6.3‑inch display, use an A20 chip built on TSMC’s 2‑nanometer process, and may incorporate Apple’s in‑house C2 modem.
Memory capacity estimates vary: analyst Ming‑Chi Kuo predicts 9 GB, while tech analyst Jeff Pu expects it to rise to 12 GB.
Additionally, the front camera is rumored to be upgraded to 24 megapixels and the camera control button may be simplified, but none of these specs have been confirmed by Apple.

items.title: ASML下一波重大晶片製造成長時間表出爐！專家：英特爾、三星、台積電掌握關鍵命脈
items.title_en: ASML's Next Major Chip Manufacturing Growth Timeline Unveiled! Experts: Intel, Samsung, TSMC Hold the Key
paras: 艾司摩爾(ASML)執行長傅恪禮(Christophe Fouquet)日前在第三季法說會上說，高數值孔徑極紫外光刻機(High-NA EUV)正從研發邁向量產，客戶進度提供設備投資下一階段時間表。對此專家表示，ASML下一波成長週期逐漸清晰，關鍵不在短期出機台數，而在英特爾、三星、台積電何時大規模導入High-NA EUV。
英特爾已用High-NA EUV曝光超過100萬片晶圓，表現達到或優於低NA同類製程層，三星則打算2028年將High-NA EUV導入大規模量產，台積電目標2030年左右用於先進邏輯。
ASML在財報會議上還說，現有High-NA EUV機台稼動率接近九成，但未來收入仍須看客戶驗證層數與擴線速度。台積電另與ASML推動12吋光罩聯盟，目標2031年建中試線、2033年量產，以降低6吋光罩拼接限制、對應大型AI晶片。
短期供需同樣吃緊。ASML預估，2027年低NA EUV與浸潤式DUV產能各年增30%，但管理層認為仍難滿足2027、2028年需求，正研究進一步擴充2028年產出，第三季淨銷售約117億歐元、毛利57.5%、淨利約50億歐元，全年營收指引上調至440至450億歐元。
ASML財務長戴厚杰(Roger Dassen)指出，High-NA EUV仍屬非常初期爬坡，客戶完成製程驗證、增加應用層別後才會帶動更多機台訂單。
對投資人而言，行情呈雙速結構：低NA與DUV升級、產能利用率提升支撐近期營收；High-NA EUV則是長期槓桿，貢獻時點取決於英特爾擴層、三星2028兌現、台積電2030導入，以及ASML交機能力。若三家大廠路線不延後，ASML可望受惠AI與先進製程資本支出長週期，但股價仍會受量產時程、單機成本與整體半導體景氣影響。
paras_en: ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet said at the Q3 earnings call that the high‑numerical‑aperture extreme ultraviolet (High‑NA EUV) lithography machine is moving from R&D to volume production, and customers are providing the next‑stage equipment‑investment schedule. Experts note that ASML's next growth cycle is becoming clearer, with the crucial factor being when Intel, Samsung and TSMC will roll out High‑NA EUV at scale rather than the short‑term number of machines shipped.

Intel has already used High‑NA EUV to expose over one million wafers, achieving performance equal to or better than comparable low‑NA processes. Samsung plans to introduce High‑NA EUV into large‑scale production in 2028, while TSMC targets around 2030 for use in advanced logic chips.

At the earnings meeting, ASML said the current High‑NA EUV machines are running at nearly 90% utilization, but future revenue will depend on how many process layers customers validate and how quickly they expand capacity. TSMC is also working with ASML on a 12‑inch mask alliance, aiming to build a pilot line by 2031 and start volume production in 2033 to reduce the 6‑inch mask stitching limitation for large AI chips.

Supply and demand remain tight in the short term. ASML forecasts a 30% annual increase in low‑NA EUV and immersion DUV capacity in 2027, yet management believes this will still fall short of 2027‑2028 demand and is studying further expansion of 2028 output. Third‑quarter net sales were about €11.7 billion, gross margin 57.5%, net profit roughly €5 billion, and full‑year revenue guidance was raised to €44‑45 billion.
CFO Roger Dassen said High‑NA EUV is still in a very early ramp‑up phase; only after customers complete process validation and add more application layers will it drive additional machine orders.

For investors, the market shows a dual‑speed structure: low‑NA and DUV upgrades and higher capacity utilization support near‑term revenue, while High‑NA EUV is a long‑term lever whose contribution timing depends on Intel’s layer expansion, Samsung’s 2028 rollout and TSMC’s 2030 adoption, as well as ASML’s delivery capacity. If the three giants stay on schedule, ASML could benefit from the long‑cycle AI and advanced‑process capital spend, though the stock will still be influenced by production timelines, per‑machine costs and overall semiconductor market conditions.

items.title: 傳字節跳動洽購聯發科AI晶片 有望成Google後第二家主要ASIC客戶
items.title_en: ByteDance in Talks to Purchase MediaTek AI Chips, Potentially Becoming Its Second Major ASIC Customer After Google
paras: 《彭博》週四 (15 日) 報導，TikTok母公司字節跳動與聯發科 (2454-TW) 的資料中心客製化晶片採購談判已進入深入階段，雙方接近達成協議。若交易敲定，字節跳動有望成為繼Google之後，聯發科第二家主要特殊應用積體電路 (ASIC) 客戶，為聯發科拓展資料中心業務增添動能。
知情人士透露，聯發科將供應依照字節跳動平台需求客製化設計的ASIC，支援其資料中心運作，但未透露供貨數量。
字節跳動未立即回應置評請求，聯發科則不予置評。
字節跳動正擴大硬體投資，押注人工智慧 (AI) 成為下一波成長引擎。
然而，與阿里巴巴 (BABA-US) 和騰訊 (0700-HK) 等中國同業一樣，字節跳動受美國出口管制限制，無法取得輝達 (NVDA-US) 等業者最先進的AI晶片，華為等中國供應商也無法滿足所有需求，促使其尋求其他供應來源。
報導指出，與晶片設計業者合作，是字節跳動探索的替代方案之一。依現行美國出口管制規定，只要相關AI運算能力未超過特定門檻，這類合作仍獲允許。
《彭博》先前曾報導，字節跳動今年稍早已與高通 (QCOM-US) 達成類似協議，採購數百萬顆AI晶片。
對聯發科而言，若能取得字節跳動的大規模訂單，將有助於業務多元化、降低對手機市場的依賴，並強化其在資料中心領域與高通、博通 (AVGO-US) 競爭的能力。科技大廠積極開發AI客製化晶片，也讓聯發科得以運用行動處理器設計經驗，擴大參與資料中心基礎建設商機。
聯發科預估，2026年相關AI晶片業務營收約達20億美元，並估計2027年客製化AI ASIC潛在市場規模可達700億至800億美元，以爭取10%至15%市占率為目標。
輝達8月底宣布，將認購聯發科35億美元可轉換公司債，並擴大雙方在AI領域的合作。隨著客製化晶片業務受到市場關注，據《彭博》報導，聯發科市值約2,100億美元，以市值計為僅次於台積電 (2330-TW、TSM-US) 的台灣第二大企業。
字節跳動的晶片需求，則來自持續擴大的AI基礎建設計畫。
《彭博》報導，該公司正考慮將今年資本支出提高至最多700億美元，超過去年的2倍，用於擴建資料中心及其他AI設施。若經濟與營運條件有利，2027年支出可能進一步增至1,000億美元。公司已於9月取得300億美元貸款，支應相關投資。
這波投資反映字節跳動正加快布局，力求鞏固在聊天機器人與AI影片等領域的早期優勢，並擴大海外影響力。旗下Seedance等主力模型，正面對阿里巴巴Happy Horse、快手 (1024-HK) 可靈AI及Google等對手的競爭。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Bloomberg reported on Thursday (the 15th) that TikTok parent ByteDance and MediaTek (2454-TW) have entered deep negotiations over custom data‑center chips, with both sides close to reaching an agreement. If the deal closes, ByteDance could become MediaTek’s second major ASIC customer after Google, adding momentum to MediaTek’s data‑center business expansion.

Sources familiar with the matter said MediaTek will supply ASICs custom‑designed to ByteDance’s platform requirements to support its data‑center operations, though the supply volume was not disclosed.
ByteDance did not immediately respond to requests for comment, and MediaTek declined to comment.
ByteDance is expanding its hardware investments, betting that artificial intelligence will be the next growth engine.

However, like Chinese peers such as Alibaba (BABA-US) and Tencent (0700-HK), ByteDance is constrained by U.S. export controls and cannot obtain the most advanced AI chips from companies like Nvidia (NVDA-US); Chinese suppliers such as Huawei also cannot meet all its needs, prompting it to look for alternative sources.

The report noted that partnering with chip designers is one of ByteDance’s explored alternatives. Under current U.S. export rules, such collaborations are still permitted as long as the AI compute capability does not exceed a certain threshold.
Bloomberg previously reported that ByteDance earlier this year reached a similar agreement with Qualcomm (QCOM-US) to purchase millions of AI chips.

For MediaTek, securing a large‑scale order from ByteDance would help diversify its business, reduce reliance on the smartphone market, and strengthen its ability to compete with Qualcomm and Broadcom (AVGO-US) in the data‑center arena. The tech giant’s push into AI‑custom chips also lets MediaTek leverage its mobile processor design expertise to capture more data‑center infrastructure opportunities.

MediaTek estimates that revenue from related AI chips could reach about $2 billion in 2026, and it projects the potential market for custom AI ASICs to be $70‑80 billion in 2027, targeting a 10‑15% market share.

Nvidia announced at the end of August that it would purchase $3.5 billion of MediaTek convertible bonds and expand cooperation in AI. As custom‑chip business draws market attention, Bloomberg said MediaTek’s market value is roughly $210 billion, making it Taiwan’s second‑largest company by market cap after TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US).
ByteDance’s chip demand stems from its continuously expanding AI infrastructure plans.

Bloomberg reported the company is considering raising its capital expenditure this year to as much as $70 billion, double last year’s level, to expand data‑centers and other AI facilities. If economic and operational conditions are favorable, spending could rise to $100 billion in 2027. The firm secured a $30 billion loan in September to fund these investments.

The investment wave reflects ByteDance’s accelerated rollout to cement early advantages in chat‑bots and AI‑generated video, while expanding its overseas influence. Its flagship models such as Seedance face competition from Alibaba’s Happy Horse, Kuaishou (1024‑HK)’s Keling AI, Google and others.
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 中國AI算力商機擴大，2027年設備邁向標準化加速本土供應鏈崛起
items.title_en: China's AI Computing Power Business Opportunities Expand, 2027 Equipment Moves Toward Standardization Accelerating Domestic Supply Chain Rise
paras: 2026年10月15日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國正加速推動全國一體化算力網建設，從過去以資料中心及算力叢集為主的基礎設施布局，逐步轉向跨區域算力調度、AI模型推論服務及Token(詞元)規模化生產。隨著人工智慧(AI)應用需求快速成長，相關商機也從AI晶片、液冷散熱、高速光通訊及電力設備，延伸至算力服務平台與下游AI應用市場，帶動整體供應鏈需求擴大。
不過，市場規模快速成長的同時，也可能加速中國本土供應鏈崛起。隨著算力基礎設施朝規模化及標準化發展，中國業者有機會透過共同技術規範降低產品開發與客戶導入成本，進一步擴大量產及提高國產替代率，對既有歐美及台灣供應商形成更直接的競爭。
中國中央政府日前發布《關於發展新質生產力的意見》，提出建設全國一體化算力網及國家區塊鏈網路，希望透過跨區域資源整合，提高資料中心與運算設備的使用效率。
根據中國工業和資訊化部統計，截至2026年6月底，中國智慧算力規模已達2,185 EFLOPS(FP16)，年增率177%；全國已建成超過70條算力傳輸通道，並核准17個國家級算力互聯互通區域節點。另一方面，全國性算力服務平台已吸引超過1萬家企業用戶註冊，上架超過2,000項算力產品，並接入超過300個大型AI模型，顯示中國算力市場正由單純擴大設備規模，逐步走向資源整合與服務化。
液冷散熱是觀察這波供應鏈變化的具體案例。中國於2026年7月發布《資料中心冷板式液冷系統技術規範》，預定2027年2月實施，已針對冷卻液分配單元(CDU)、快速接頭及分水歧管(Manifold)訂出明確的性能與測試要求。
其中，標準建議不同廠商生產的相同規格快速接頭應具備互換能力，CDU實際換熱能力須達額定值95%以上，穩態供液溫度偏差不得超過±1°C，分水歧管各支路最大與最小流量差異則不得超過平均流量的10%。這些技術規範有助於建立共同的產品驗證基礎，未來若獲得大型資料中心廣泛採用，將提高不同供應商產品的可比較性，也可能降低客戶對特定品牌的依賴。
目前中國液冷供應鏈的國產替代進度，已開始在不同零組件之間出現分化。CDU系統整合、液冷管路、分水歧管及部分液冷泵浦的本土供應能力相對成熟，快速接頭的國產化也持續提升；但高階晶片液冷板、精密調節閥及特殊冷卻液仍面臨較高的技術與客戶認證門檻。現有資料尚不足以量化各環節的實際國產替代率，因此仍須區分產品開發、客戶認證與正式量產供貨的不同階段。

在系統整合方面，英維克Envicool(002837-CN)已建立涵蓋CDU、液冷板、快速接頭、管路及冷卻液的產品組合，其UQD快速接頭於2024年進入輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US) MGX生態系，並布局符合Google液冷技術規格的CDU產品。申菱環境(301018-CN)則投入人民幣8億元建設液冷製造基地，高瀾股份(300499-CN)也持續擴展資料中心液冷業務，反映中國業者正從產品開發走向產能擴張。
在零組件領域，川環科技(300547-CN)利用汽車流體管路製造經驗切入AI伺服器液冷市場，並推進產品認證；飛龍股份(002536-CN)、大元泵業(603757-CN)則利用既有泵浦技術布局資料中心液冷設備。這些企業原本就具備精密加工與大量製造能力，若能進一步通過資料中心客戶驗證，將有機會在標準化零組件市場擴大供應。

至於技術門檻較高的液冷板，中國業者也開始建立市場地位。根據Omdia資料，浪潮信息Inspur(000977-CN)於2024年全球單相液冷板細分市場的銷售額占比達17.5%，顯示中國供應商已在部分產品市場具備規模競爭力。思泉新材(301489-CN)則投入人民幣3,159萬元建設液冷研發中心，布局高階AI晶片液冷板；銀輪股份(002126-CN)聚焦資料中心板式熱交換器及液冷模組零組件，中石科技(300684-CN)也持續擴展伺服器散熱材料與液冷產品。
此外，液冷需求也向上游材料及製造設備延伸。金田股份(601609-CN)規劃投資人民幣6億元，在越南建設年產3萬噸液冷散熱及機架母線用高精密銅排項目；鼎通科技(688668-CN)則規劃於2026年增加三條液冷產線，顯示中國相關企業正提前布局製造能力，以爭取未來AI散熱設備訂單。
對既有歐美及台灣液冷供應商而言，中國算力網建設雖然有望擴大整體市場需求，但隨著本土業者在CDU、管路、泵浦及部分液冷零組件逐步建立量產能力，供應鏈競爭也可能更加激烈。尤其通用性較高、容易依照共同規格生產的產品，未來可能率先面臨國產替代及價格壓力；相較之下，高階晶片液冷板、精密快速接頭及流體控制系統，仍須依靠長期可靠性驗證與客戶認證維持競爭優勢。

paras_en: October 15, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – China is accelerating the construction of a nationwide integrated computing power network, shifting from a past infrastructure layout focused on data centers and compute clusters to cross‑regional compute scheduling, AI model inference services, and token‑scale production. As AI application demand grows rapidly, related business opportunities extend from AI chips, liquid‑cooling heat dissipation, high‑speed optical communications and power equipment to compute service platforms and downstream AI application markets, driving overall supply‑chain demand expansion.

However, while the market size grows quickly, it may also speed up the rise of China’s domestic supply chain. As compute infrastructure moves toward scale and standardization, Chinese firms have the chance to lower product development and customer integration costs through common technical specifications, further expanding mass production and increasing the domestic substitution rate, creating more direct competition for existing European, American and Taiwanese suppliers.

China’s central government recently issued the “Opinions on Developing New‑Quality Productivity,” proposing the construction of a nationwide integrated computing power network and a national blockchain network, aiming to improve data‑center and computing‑equipment utilization efficiency through cross‑regional resource integration.

According to statistics from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, by the end of June 2026 China’s smart computing power capacity reached 2,185 EFLOPS (FP16), a 177% year‑on‑year increase; the country has built more than 70 computing‑power transmission channels and approved 17 national‑level computing‑power interconnection regional nodes. Meanwhile, a nationwide computing‑power service platform has attracted over 10,000 enterprise users, listed more than 2,000 computing‑power products, and integrated over 300 large AI models, showing that China’s computing‑power market is moving from merely expanding equipment scale to resource integration and service orientation.

Liquid‑cooling heat dissipation is a concrete example of this supply‑chain shift. In July 2026 China released the “Data‑Center Cold‑Plate Liquid‑Cooling System Technical Specification,” slated for implementation in February 2027, which sets clear performance and testing requirements for cooling‑fluid distribution units (CDU), quick connectors, and manifolds.

The standard recommends that quick connectors of the same specification from different manufacturers be interchangeable, that CDUs achieve at least 95% of their rated heat‑transfer capacity, that steady‑state supply‑fluid temperature deviation not exceed ±1 °C, and that the maximum‑minimum flow‑rate difference among manifold branches not exceed 10% of the average flow. These technical specs help create a common product‑verification basis; if widely adopted by large data centers, they will improve comparability of products from different suppliers and may reduce customer reliance on specific brands.

China’s domestic liquid‑cooling supply chain is already showing differentiation across components. The integration of CDU systems, liquid‑cooling pipelines, manifolds and some liquid‑cooling pumps is relatively mature, and the domesticization of quick connectors is also advancing; however, high‑end chip liquid‑cooling plates, precision regulation valves and special coolants still face higher technical and customer‑certification hurdles. Existing data are insufficient to quantify the actual domestic substitution rate for each link, so distinctions must be made among product development, customer certification and full‑scale production stages.

In system integration, Envicool (002837‑CN) has built a product portfolio covering CDUs, liquid‑cooling plates, quick connectors, pipelines and coolant, with its UQD quick connector entering NVIDIA’s (NVDA‑US) MGX ecosystem in 2024 and positioning CDU products that meet Google’s liquid‑cooling specifications. Shenling Environment (301018‑CN) has invested RMB 800 million to build a liquid‑cooling manufacturing base, and Gaolan Co. (300499‑CN) continues to expand its data‑center liquid‑cooling business, reflecting Chinese firms moving from product development to capacity expansion.

In component manufacturing, Chuanhuan Technology (300547‑CN) leverages automotive fluid‑pipeline experience to enter the AI‑server liquid‑cooling market and advance product certification; Feilong Co. (002536‑CN) and Dayuan Pump (603757‑CN) use existing pump technology to position themselves in data‑center liquid‑cooling equipment. These companies already possess precision machining and high‑volume manufacturing capabilities, and if they pass data‑center customer verification, they could expand supply in the standardized component market.

Regarding the higher‑tech barrier liquid‑cooling plates, Chinese firms are also gaining market foothold. According to Omdia, Inspur (000977‑CN) accounted for 17.5% of global single‑phase liquid‑cooling‑plate sales in 2024, showing Chinese suppliers have achieved scale competitiveness in certain product segments. Siquan New Materials (301489‑CN) has invested RMB 31.59 million to build a liquid‑cooling R&D center for high‑end AI‑chip plates; Yinlun Co. (002126‑CN) focuses on data‑center plate heat exchangers and liquid‑cooling modules, while Zhongshi Technology (300684‑CN) continues to expand server thermal‑material and liquid‑cooling product lines.

Furthermore, liquid‑cooling demand extends upstream to materials and manufacturing equipment. Jintian Co. (601609‑CN) plans to invest RMB 600 million to build a high‑precision copper‑bar project in Vietnam with an annual capacity of 30,000 tons for liquid‑cooling heat dissipation and rack backplane use; Dingtong Technology (688668‑CN) plans to add three liquid‑cooling production lines in 2026, indicating Chinese firms are pre‑positioning manufacturing capacity to capture future AI‑cooling equipment orders.

For existing European, American and Taiwanese liquid‑cooling suppliers, China’s computing‑power network construction is likely to expand overall market demand, but as domestic players gradually establish mass‑production capability for CDUs, pipelines, pumps and some liquid‑cooling components, supply‑chain competition could intensify. Products with high universality and easy compliance with common specs may face domestic substitution and price pressure first; by contrast, high‑end chip liquid‑cooling plates, precision quick connectors and fluid‑control systems will still need long‑term reliability validation and customer certification to maintain competitive advantage.

items.title: Arm敗訴僅賠高通2美元！數十億美元權利金豁免成決戰關鍵
items.title_en: Arm Loses Lawsuit but Pays Qualcomm Only $2! Billion‑Dollar Royalty Waiver Becomes Decisive Issue
paras: 美國德拉瓦州聯邦陪審團10月13日作出裁決，認定晶片技術供應商Arm違反與高通(QCOM-US)的許可協議，並故意干預高通(QCOM-US)與Meta Platforms(META-US)的商業關係。然而，陪審團僅判處Arm向高通支付2美元的名義損害賠償，使得雙方均從裁決中尋得「勝利」的依據。
這項象徵性賠償背後，真正左右未來格局的將是接下來即將裁定的五年權利金豁免問題，涉及金額可能高達數十億美元。
經過為期五天的審理，德拉瓦州陪審團認定Arm違反了其與高通長期有效的架構許可協議（ALA），具體表現為未能履行向高通提供晶片設計所需軟體修補程式和測試工具的義務。此外，陪審團還認定Arm故意且過失地干預了高通與Meta之間的商業關係。
高通此前指控稱，2024年公司與Meta的一筆晶片供應協議已接近達成，但Arm向《彭博社》洩露了高通違反許可協議的通知，導致Meta對高通的授權狀態產生疑慮，交易因此被推遲，協議價值縮水約1.7億美元。
然而，儘管兩項指控成立，陪審團對每項違規僅判處1美元賠償，合計2美元。此外，陪審團還在高通提出的另外五項違約指控中，作出了有利於Arm的認定。
高通僅獲得2美元的賠償金額看似荒誕，實則具有明確的法律意涵。名義損害（nominal damages）賠償的判處意味著陪審團認可了高通指控Arm存在法律上的過錯，但認為高通未能證明其遭受了可直接量化的經濟損失。
Arm的律師也表示，高通所謂的損害更多是推測性的，而非實質性的財務損失。
正因如此，雙方在裁決後都迅速發表聲明，各自宣示「勝利」。
高通的聲明強調：「我們感到欣慰，因為陪審團認定Arm違反了雙方長期有效的架構許可協議，未能兌現承諾，並故意採取行動擾亂高通的業務。」高通還表示，這一結果「進一步暴露了Arm損害高通及其生態系統的更廣泛意圖」。
Arm的回應同樣積極：「我們對陪審團的裁決感到滿意，該裁決在四項訴求上支持Arm，並就高通另外兩項訴求分別僅判賠1美元。」Arm強調，這一結果「印證了Arm在技術許可協議項下出於善意行事」。
五年權利金豁免懸而未決
本次法庭裁決的2美元賠償金本身無關痛癢，但其背後的違約認定卻為高通打開了通往更大法律利益的大門。
高通正在尋求依據許可協議中的一項條款，主張由於Arm違約，高通有權在五年內停止向Arm支付權利金。據《路透社》報導，這筆金額可能高達數十億美元。Arm則主張，該五年權利金罰則條款「無法強制執行」。
此爭議將由美國聯邦地區法官Maryellen Noreika裁決，而非陪審團。Noreika法官同時還需裁定另一項關鍵問題：Arm是否就下一代技術（ARMv10）與高通進行了善意協商。
庭審中披露的一個細節加劇了雙方在下一代技術定價上的對立：高通的律師引用圖表顯示，Arm尋求將其計算架構從第9版升級到第10版時，專利費提高1800%。而Arm的律師則反問高通執行長安蒙，2013年協議中每顆晶片1.88美元的專利費上限，在資料中心晶片擁有288個核心的2026年是否還合理。
可以說，Noreika法官後續關於五年權利金豁免的認定，將決定高通與Arm這場法律戰的實際經濟後果。無論結果如何，敗訴一方幾乎必然會提起上訴，這場橫跨數年的晶片巨頭法律戰遠未到終局。
paras_en: On October 13, a federal jury in Delaware ruled that chip‑technology supplier Arm violated its licensing agreement with Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) and deliberately interfered with Qualcomm’s business relationship with Meta Platforms (META‑US). However, the jury awarded only a nominal $2 in damages to Qualcomm, allowing both sides to claim a "victory" from the verdict.

Behind this symbolic award, the real determinant of the future landscape will be the upcoming decision on a five‑year royalty‑waiver issue that could involve amounts in the tens of billions of dollars.

After a five‑day trial, the Delaware jury found that Arm breached its long‑standing Architecture License Agreement (ALA) with Qualcomm by failing to provide the software patches and testing tools needed for chip design. The jury also concluded that Arm deliberately and negligently interfered with Qualcomm’s commercial relationship with Meta.

Qualcomm had previously alleged that a chip‑supply deal with Meta in 2024 was close to completion, but Arm leaked to Bloomberg that Qualcomm had violated the licensing agreement, causing Meta to doubt Qualcomm’s licensing status. The deal was delayed and its value shrank by about $170 million.

Nevertheless, although both allegations were upheld, the jury awarded only $1 in damages for each violation, totaling $2. In addition, the jury ruled in favor of Arm on five other breach claims raised by Qualcomm.

Qualcomm’s $2 award may seem absurd, but it carries a clear legal meaning. The nominal‑damages award indicates that the jury recognized Qualcomm’s claim that Arm committed a legal wrong, but found that Qualcomm failed to prove any directly quantifiable economic loss.
Arm’s lawyers also said that Qualcomm’s alleged damages are largely speculative rather than actual financial losses.
For that reason, both parties quickly issued statements after the verdict, each proclaiming a "victory."

Qualcomm’s statement emphasized: "We are pleased that the jury found Arm breached the long‑standing Architecture License Agreement, failed to fulfill its commitments, and deliberately acted to disrupt Qualcomm’s business." Qualcomm added that the result "further exposes Arm’s broader intent to harm Qualcomm and its ecosystem."

Arm’s response was equally upbeat: "We are satisfied with the jury’s decision, which supports Arm on four of the claims and awards only $1 for each of Qualcomm’s two remaining claims." Arm stressed that the outcome "confirms that Arm acted in good faith under the technology licensing agreement."
Five‑Year Royalty Waiver Still Unresolved
The $2 damages award itself is immaterial, but the breach findings open the door for Qualcomm to pursue much larger legal benefits.

Qualcomm is seeking to invoke a clause in the licensing agreement that, because of Arm’s breach, gives Qualcomm the right to stop paying royalties to Arm for five years. Reuters reports that the amount at stake could reach tens of billions of dollars. Arm argues that the five‑year royalty‑penalty clause "cannot be enforced."

The dispute will be decided by U.S. District Judge Maryellen Noreika, not the jury. Judge Noreika must also rule on another key issue: whether Arm engaged in good‑faith negotiations with Qualcomm over next‑generation technology (ARMv10).

A detail revealed during the trial heightened the pricing clash over next‑generation tech: Qualcomm’s lawyers presented a chart showing that when Arm sought to upgrade its compute architecture from version 9 to version 10, patent fees jumped 1,800%. Arm’s counsel retorted by asking Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon whether the 2013 agreement’s $1.88 per‑chip patent‑fee cap remains reasonable in 2026, when data‑center chips have 288 cores.

Judge Noreika’s forthcoming ruling on the five‑year royalty waiver will determine the actual economic outcome of the legal battle between Qualcomm and Arm. Regardless of the result, the losing party is almost certain to appeal, and this multi‑year chip‑giant lawsuit is far from over.

items.title: 一檔股票拖垮全球半導體？財經名嘴：美晶片股是看SK海力士臉色　不是輝達
items.title_en: One Stock Dragging Down Global Semiconductors? CNBC Host: US Chip Stocks Follow SK Hynix, Not Nvidia
paras: SK海力士正處於全球記憶體晶片拋售潮風暴中心，近六日ADR股價跌逾15%，今(15)日早盤在南韓市場崩逾10%，美光、西部數據、希捷週三(14日)跌近2%。對此《CNBC》名嘴Jim Cramer指出，SK海力士與SMH半導體ETF成分股高度連動，美股晶片族群更跟海力士連動，非只跟輝達，其記憶體業務規模與價格指標意義，令SK海力士成為更廣泛半導體賣壓的領頭羊。
晶片股拋售潮表面上是獲利了結，深層則在重估三件事：一是中國長鑫存儲推進4F²架構、預計今年底推出伺服器DDR5，通用DRAM與伺服器記憶體供給預期生變；二是AI資本支出回報受質疑，市場怕HBM漲價循環見頂；三是利率走高壓縮高成長股容錯空間。
Roundhill策略師Drew Pettit表示，記憶體類股經過獲利預期大幅上修後進入「轉型期」，投資人開始追問成長能否延續，任何負面消息都被放大。
不過，中國威脅目前有邊界。美國財富管理與投行D.A. Davidson董事總經理Gil Luria表示，長鑫存儲份額與技術確實提升，但主力仍在通用DRAM及中低端，HBM由SK海力士、三星主導，且難供應微軟、谷歌、亞馬遜、蘋果、輝達等美系大客戶。若僅計算通用記憶體價格壓力，SK海力士、三星受影響較大，美光相對免疫。
Luria也對半導體週期仍偏樂觀，理由是中國AI供應鏈業績、展望與能見度改善。
對SK海力士而言，短線要看中國擴產、外資賣超與HBM毛利可持續性；中長線仍看SK海力士在高堆疊HBM的領先地位與AI伺服器綁定。
Cramer建議別只盯短線，應回到AI系統與終端設備記憶體需求成長，但在估值已反映高預期下，任何量產遞延、客戶驗證或中國低價滲透消息，都可能繼續放大波動。
paras_en: SK Hynix is at the center of a global memory chip sell‑off storm, with its ADR falling more than 15% over the past six days and its South Korean market price plunging over 10% in early trading today (the 15th). Micron, Western Digital and Seagate each slipped about 2% on Wednesday (the 14th). CNBC host Jim Cramer noted that SK Hynix is highly correlated with the SMH semiconductor ETF, and that U.S. chip stocks are moving in tandem with Hynix—not just Nvidia—because its memory business size and pricing benchmarks make SK Hynix the leading driver of broader semiconductor selling pressure.

The chip‑stock sell‑off looks on the surface like profit‑taking, but deeper it reflects a re‑evaluation of three factors: first, China’s ChangXin Memory is advancing its 4F² architecture and expects to launch server DDR5 by year‑end, potentially reshaping supply of commodity DRAM and server memory; second, the return on AI capital expenditures is being questioned, with the market fearing that the HBM price‑rise cycle may have peaked; third, rising interest rates are compressing the margin for error in high‑growth stocks.

Roundhill strategist Drew Pettit said memory stocks have entered a "transformation phase" after profit expectations were sharply upgraded, and investors are now probing whether growth can be sustained, so any negative news gets amplified.

However, the Chinese threat has limits. Gil Luria, managing director at U.S. wealth‑management and investment‑banking firm D.A. Davidson, said ChangXin’s market share and technology are indeed improving, but its focus remains on commodity DRAM and mid‑to‑low‑end segments. HBM is dominated by SK Hynix and Samsung and is difficult to supply to major U.S. customers such as Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Apple and Nvidia. If you look only at pressure on commodity memory prices, SK Hynix and Samsung are more affected, while Micron is relatively insulated.
Luria also remains somewhat optimistic about the semiconductor cycle, citing improving performance, outlook and visibility for China’s AI supply chain.

For SK Hynix, the short‑term outlook hinges on Chinese capacity expansion, foreign‑investor net selling, and the sustainability of HBM margins; the medium‑to‑long term still depends on SK Hynix’s leading position in high‑stack HBM and its tie‑in with AI servers.

Cramer advises not to focus solely on the short term but to return to the growth in memory demand from AI systems and end‑device equipment. Yet, with valuations already reflecting lofty expectations, any delays in mass production, customer validation issues, or news of low‑price penetration from China could continue to magnify volatility.

items.title: 波克夏加碼3.3億美元入股 Bending Spoons暴漲超40%
items.title_en: Berkshire Adds $330 Million Stake in Bending Spoons, Shares Surge Over 40%
paras: 多家外媒報導，義大利軟體收購業者 Bending Spoons (BSP-US) 獲波克夏·海瑟威 (BRK.B-US) 追加投資3.3億美元，帶動股價週三 (14日) 飆漲逾40%。然而，這家公司的估值並不便宜，也讓向來重視價值的波克夏為何出手，成為市場關注焦點。
根據證券申報文件，Bending Spoons 將以每股33美元，向波克夏發行1,000萬股普通股，交易完成後，波克夏持股比重將達4%。此次募得資金將提高公司推動收購的財務彈性。
這是波克夏今年第二度投資 Bending Spoons。今年7月，該公司於那斯達克首次公開發行股票 (IPO) 時，波克夏已投入6億美元，加計此次追加投資，累計投入達9.3億美元。隨著股價大漲，波克夏這筆持股的帳面獲利估計已達約6億美元。
不過，依週三公告揭露的股數推算，Bending Spoons 市值約400億美元，IPO時另有約40億美元債務。若以股權市值加計債務的企業價值衡量，估值接近預估年營收的10倍；以2027年預估獲利計算，本益比則約30倍。
這樣的買進估值，與波克夏過往部分大型投資形成鮮明對比。巴菲特 (Warren Buffett) 師承價值投資大師葛拉漢，長期重視買進價格與企業價值之間的關係。即使是波克夏最成功的股票投資之一、目前最大持股蘋果 (AAPL-US)，在2016年至2018年大舉買進時，本益比也不到15倍。
Bending Spoons 主要透過收購軟體及訂閱制應用程式拓展事業版圖。共同創辦人暨企業收購主管 Francesco Patarnello 表示，公司持續評估併購機會，目前潛在交易案源仍相當充足。
Patarnello 認為，波克夏追加投資反映其對公司團隊與營運平台的信心，也將強化財務調度能力，協助公司配合整體融資策略，把握具吸引力的收購機會。
支持者則看好 Bending Spoons 收購後的整合與經營能力。Durable Capital Partners 創辦人暨投資長 Henry Ellenbogen 今年7月表示，看好該公司每名員工創造的營收及稅息折舊攤銷前獲利 (EBITDA) 持續提升，進而推動內生成長，並讓營收擴張帶來更大幅度的獲利成長。
從波克夏整體布局來看，這家投資集團近一年也增加了科技股投資，目前持有逾1億股 Alphabet (GOOGL-US)，其中包括今年6月以每股不到350美元、斥資100億美元買進的部位。
不過，Alphabet 的買進由巴菲特主導，Bending Spoons 這筆投資究竟由誰拍板，目前仍不清楚。
阿貝爾 (Greg Abel) 今年初接替巴菲特出任波克夏執行長，目前負責監督約3,500億美元的股票投資組合。投資經理魏許勒 (Ted Weschler) 管理其中約6%，巴菲特也仍參與投資決策。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported that Italian software‑acquisition firm Bending Spoons (BSP‑US) received an additional $330 million investment from Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B‑US), sending its stock up more than 40% on Wednesday (the 14th). The company’s valuation is far from cheap, prompting market observers to wonder why value‑focused Berkshire would step in.

According to securities filing documents, Bending Spoons will issue 10 million common shares to Berkshire at $33 per share, giving Berkshire a 4% ownership stake after the transaction. The capital raised will increase the company’s financial flexibility for future acquisitions.

This is Berkshire’s second investment in Bending Spoons this year. When the company went public on Nasdaq in July, Berkshire had already put $600 million into it; with the new infusion, total investment reaches $930 million. The share price jump means Berkshire’s paper profit on the holding is now roughly $600 million.

Based on the share count disclosed on Wednesday, Bending Spoons is valued at about $40 billion, with roughly $4 billion of debt at IPO. Measured by equity market cap plus debt (enterprise value), the valuation is close to ten times projected 2027 revenue; using projected 2027 earnings, the price‑to‑earnings multiple is about 30×.

Such a purchase price contrasts sharply with many of Berkshire’s past large‑cap bets. Warren Buffett, a disciple of value‑investing guru Graham, has long emphasized the relationship between purchase price and intrinsic value. Even Berkshire’s most successful equity holding, Apple (AAPL‑US), was bought at a P/E below 15× during the massive 2016‑2018 buying spree.

Bending Spoons expands its business mainly through acquiring software and subscription‑based apps. Co‑founder and corporate‑development head Francesco Patarnello said the company continues to evaluate acquisition opportunities and that the pipeline of potential deals remains robust.

Patarnello believes Berkshire’s follow‑on investment reflects confidence in the team and operating platform, and will strengthen financial flexibility, helping the company execute its broader financing strategy and seize attractive acquisition targets.

Supporters are optimistic about Bending Spoons’ post‑acquisition integration and operating capabilities. Henry Ellenbogen, founder and CIO of Durable Capital Partners, said in July he is bullish on the firm’s per‑employee revenue and EBITDA growth, which should drive organic expansion and translate revenue growth into outsized profit gains.

Looking at Berkshire’s overall positioning, the conglomerate has increased its tech‑stock exposure over the past year, now holding more than 100 million shares of Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), including a $10 billion purchase in June at just under $350 per share.
However, the Alphabet purchase was led by Buffett himself, and it remains unclear who approved the Bending Spoons investment.

Greg Abel took over from Buffett as Berkshire’s CEO earlier this year and now oversees roughly $350 billion of equity holdings. Investment manager Ted Weschler runs about 6% of that portfolio, while Buffett still participates in investment decisions.

items.title: IMF：明年日本GDP恐被印度、英國超車 降至全球第六
items.title_en: IMF: Japan’s GDP May Be Overtaken by India and the UK Next Year, Dropping to Sixth Globally
paras: 國際貨幣基金（IMF）周二（13日）發布的最新一期《世界經濟展望報告》顯示，按名義GDP計算，日本經濟規模預估將在2027年首次被英國和印度超越，全球排名從第四降至第六。
根據IMF報告，日本今年名義GDP預計為4.34兆美元，位居全球第四；英國和印度分別為4.27兆美元和4.06兆美元。但到2027年，印度GDP預計將增至4.52兆美元，排名第四；英國以4.49兆美元緊追其後，日本則以4.47兆美元位居第六。
全球經濟環境日益動盪，使未來經濟前景更加難以預測。與此同時，過去幾年，日元兌美元匯率持續走弱，削弱了日本的購買力，而生活成本不斷提高，也給家庭帶來更大壓力。在此背景下，日本在多項經濟排名中的位置持續下滑。
此外，人口老齡化和經濟增長乏力，也給日本未來的經濟前景帶來挑戰。
IMF對今年全球經濟成長預測上修至3.1%，高於7月所估的3%，主因是AI投資熱潮抵銷了能源成本飆升造成的部分衝擊。
IMF對2026年的最新預估，低於去年的3.5%，2027年成長率預料將加速至3.4%，維持先前預測。
IMF預期今年全球通膨率為4.7%，維持先前預測，2027年通膨率預估為4.1%，高於7月預測的3.9%。
IMF預估荷姆茲海峽將於明年3月重新開放，中東情勢到2027年10月可望恢復至戰前狀態。報告顯示，9月波斯灣原油出口量已回升至衝突前平均水準88%。
paras_en: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) released its latest World Economic Outlook on Tuesday (the 13th), showing that, based on nominal GDP, Japan’s economy is projected to be overtaken by the United Kingdom and India for the first time in 2027, slipping from fourth to sixth place worldwide.

According to the IMF report, Japan’s nominal GDP this year is expected to be $4.34 trillion, ranking fourth globally; the UK and India are forecast at $4.27 trillion and $4.06 trillion respectively. By 2027, India’s GDP is projected to rise to $4.52 trillion, taking fourth place; the UK will follow with $4.49 trillion, while Japan will fall to $4.47 trillion and rank sixth.

The global economic environment is becoming increasingly volatile, making future outlooks harder to predict. At the same time, the yen has continued to weaken against the dollar over recent years, eroding Japan’s purchasing power, and rising living costs are putting greater strain on households. Against this backdrop, Japan’s position in several economic rankings has been steadily declining.
In addition, an aging population and sluggish economic growth pose further challenges to Japan’s future economic prospects.

The IMF has raised its forecast for global economic growth this year to 3.1%, up from the 3% estimated in July, mainly because a surge in AI investment is offsetting some of the impact of soaring energy costs.
The IMF’s latest projection for 2026 is lower than last year’s 3.5%, while growth in 2027 is expected to accelerate to 3.4%, consistent with its earlier forecast.
The IMF expects global inflation to be 4.7% this year, unchanged from its prior outlook, and projects inflation at 4.1% in 2027, higher than the July forecast of 3.9%.

The IMF projects the Hormuz Strait will reopen in March next year, and that the Middle‑East situation could return to pre‑war conditions by October 2027. The report shows that September’s Persian Gulf oil exports have already rebounded to 88% of pre‑conflict average levels.

items.title: CoreWeave擴張AI轉向保險業尋資金 創辦人：必須成為巨頭
items.title_en: CoreWeave Expands AI Push into Insurance Funding; Founder Says It Must Become a Giant
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，由輝達(NVDA-US)支持的CoreWeave(CRWV-US)，正尋求引入保險業資金，因為 AI 基礎建設的擴張日益仰賴債務融資。
CoreWeave 共同創辦人 Brannin McBee 在週三(14日)刊出的《金融時報》專訪中表示，公司正尋求取得保險公司的龐大投資資金，以爭取成本可能更低的融資。McBee 表示，若能取得更高的投資等級信用評等，將有助於公司向保險公司借款，而這些機構的資金「是無限的」。
公司也正在評估，保險公司是否能購買由信用評等較低的客戶所提供擔保的貸款，其中包括 AI 研究實驗室。McBee 表示，這類交易目前尚未準備好推向保險市場。
CoreWeave 正評估增加可延後動用的定期貸款，以加快資料中心建設及設備採購。McBee 將這種做法比擬為透過預先出售合約，為發電廠融資。
他表示，未來 AI 研究實驗室若上市，可能改善這些公司的信用狀況；與此同時，CoreWeave 仍以躋身業界最大型基礎建設供應商之列為目標。
McBee 表示：「如果我們今天停止建設，就會有極為龐大的正向現金流。」但他也指出：「我們正處於一個必須做得夠大的時期。你必須成為規模最大的業者之一。」
CoreWeave 的融資策略出爐之際，科技與金融業的高階主管紛紛警告，資金可取得性可能成為限制 AI 基礎建設成長的一大因素。
AI熱潮面臨融資風險 成本持續攀升
共同創辦人 McBee 發表上述言論之際，投資人 Chamath Palihapitiya 正質疑 AI 熱潮是否正在助長私人信貸泡沫。此前，CoreWeave 2032 年到期債券的殖利率一度升至 15%，最後以創紀錄的 14.5% 收盤。
Palihapitiya 強調，市場對債務、租賃及其他融資方式的依賴日益增加。美國直接放款市場規模已從 2010 年的 960 億美元，激增至 2025 年的 2.4 兆美元。2025 年直接貸款市場中，科技企業占 1.05 兆美元，占比達 44%；其中，提供給 AI、大數據及雲端公司的貸款超過 2,000 億美元。
高盛執行長蘇德巍(David Solomon)週二表示，AI 運算需求持續超越供給，但他警告，龐大的融資需求可能推高借貸成本，並威脅部分專案的可行性。他指出，利率上升可能壓縮投資報酬，使部分專案更難取得融資。
不過，Solomon 也表示，運算能力需求持續超越供給，將支持更多建設與融資活動。
本週稍早，博通(AVGO-US)執行長陳福陽警告，取得資金可能比晶片或電力短缺更容易成為 AI 基礎建設擴張的瓶頸。他指出，運算需求可能持續超越供給，直到 2029 年或 2030 年。
英特爾(INTC-US)執行長陳立武則對高昂的借貸成本，以及 AI 投資能否帶來足夠報酬以證明相關支出合理，表達擔憂。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that CoreWeave (CRWV-US), backed by Nvidia (NVDA-US), is seeking to bring insurance‑industry capital into its AI infrastructure expansion, which is increasingly reliant on debt financing.

CoreWeave co‑founder Brannin McBee told the Financial Times on Wednesday (the 14th) that the company is looking for large investments from insurers to secure potentially cheaper financing. McBee said that a higher investment‑grade credit rating would help the firm borrow from insurers, whose capital “is limitless.”

The firm is also evaluating whether insurers could purchase loans backed by lower‑rated borrowers, including AI research labs. McBee noted that such transactions are not yet ready for the insurance market.

CoreWeave is assessing the addition of longer‑term, delayed‑draw term loans to accelerate data‑center construction and equipment purchases. McBee likened the approach to financing a power plant by pre‑selling contracts.

He added that if AI research labs eventually go public, it could improve those companies’ credit profiles; meanwhile CoreWeave still aims to become one of the largest infrastructure providers in the industry.
McBee said, “If we stop building today, we would have an enormous positive cash flow.” He also warned, “We are at a point where we have to be big enough. You have to be one of the biggest players.”
As CoreWeave’s financing strategy emerges, senior executives in tech and finance are warning that the availability of capital could become a major constraint on AI infrastructure growth.
AI hype faces financing risk as costs keep climbing

When co‑founder McBee made those remarks, investor Chamath Palihapitiya questioned whether the AI boom is fueling a private‑credit bubble. Earlier, CoreWeave’s 2032 bond yield had spiked to 15% before closing at a record 14.5%.

Palihapitiya stressed that reliance on debt, leasing and other financing is growing. The U.S. direct‑lending market has surged from $96 billion in 2010 to $2.4 trillion projected for 2025. In 2025, tech firms will account for $1.05 trillion (44%) of that market, with loans to AI, big‑data and cloud companies exceeding $200 billion.

Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon said on Tuesday that AI compute demand continues to outpace supply, but warned that massive financing needs could push borrowing costs higher and threaten the viability of some projects. He noted that rising rates could compress investment returns, making financing harder to obtain for certain projects.
Nevertheless, Solomon added that the ongoing gap between compute demand and supply will continue to drive construction and financing activity.

Earlier this week, Broadcom (AVGO-US) CEO Hock Tan warned that securing funding could become a bigger bottleneck for AI infrastructure expansion than chip or power shortages. He said compute demand may stay ahead of supply through 2029 or 2030.
Intel (INTC-US) CEO Pat Gelsinger expressed concern about the high cost of borrowing and whether AI investments can generate enough returns to justify the spending.

items.title: 鏈結資產中心(AegisClear) 計畫收購幣護 Aegis Custody Taiwan
items.title_en: AegisClear Plans to Acquire Aegis Custody Taiwan
paras: AegisClear 總部位於高雄金融科技創新園區，並獲所有台灣投資人的支持，宣布計畫收購位於台北的幣護股份有限公司 Aegis Custody Taiwan。

此次收購涵蓋多項專有技術，包括HSM硬體安全模組（Hardware Security Module）數位資產託管解決方案、銀行級穩定幣發行解決方案，以及實體世界資產（Real-World Asset, RWA）私人信貸代幣化解決方案。此次新增的源代碼將進一步強化 AegisClear 的技術能力，並支持台灣「亞洲資產管理中心（Asian Asset Management Center, AAMC）」倡議。
鏈結資產中心共同創辦人 Serra Wei 表示：「台灣如今已是全球第四大股票市場，並創造了龐大的財富。我們希望加速台灣在亞洲市場的發展，使台灣成為家族辦公室及金融機構取得高品質代幣化資產的樞紐，並能夠使用台灣核准的穩定幣進行資產配置。」
鏈結資產中心的數位資產 HSM硬體安全模組（Hardware Security Module）託管解決方案，結合安全性、可擴展性與合規性，用於管理及保護數位資產、保障加密金鑰安全，以及執行加密運算，具備 SOC 2 安全標準認證，符合金融機構對數位資產託管的技術規格要求。同時，其架構符合 台灣VASP（虛擬資產服務提供者）相關合規要求，並遵循嚴格的反洗錢（AML）及了解你的客戶（KYC）規範。
關於鏈結資產中心(AegisClear)
鏈結資產中心認為，金融的下一個時代不只是單純將資產「上鏈」，更重要的是將資產、資本、金融機構與全球市場連結起來，以創造更高的信任、效率與可及性。透過連結傳統金融資產、數位資產及穩定幣技術，鏈結資產中心為機構提供高效、透明且具互通性的託管及結算支付基礎設施。
Aegis Group 生態系統包括位於美國的 Aegis Trust Company、位於香港的 Digital Asset Clearing Center（「DACC.HK」），以及 Tokenization Foundation。

Aegis Trust Company 提供數位資產託管、法幣出入金（fiat on- and off-ramp）、基於託管的質押（staking）以及代幣化資產相關服務，並受適用法律、監管要求及服務可用性的限制。
DACC.HK 專注於數位資產結算基礎設施及跨境金融科技應用，包括數位債券、穩定幣、中央銀行數位貨幣（CBDC）及跨境支付相關技術的探索。
Tokenization Foundation（代幣化基金會） 是一家 501(c)(3) 慈善組織，建立全世界第一檔聚焦於社會影響力的代幣化貨幣市場基金，並透過ＡI與區塊鏈技術支持災害應變及人道救援。


AegisClear 專注於安全、創新與卓越營運，致力於發展連結傳統金融與數位資產管理的科技基礎設施。
網站： http://aegisclear.com
paras_en: AegisClear, headquartered in the Kaohsiung FinTech Innovation Park and backed by all Taiwanese investors, announced its plan to acquire Aegis Custody Taiwan, a company based in Taipei.

The acquisition includes several proprietary technologies, such as a Hardware Security Module (HSM) digital‑asset custody solution, a bank‑grade stablecoin issuance solution, and a real‑world asset (RWA) private‑credit tokenization solution. The added source code will further strengthen AegisClear’s technical capabilities and support Taiwan’s Asian Asset Management Center (AAMC) initiative.

Co‑founder of AegisClear, Serra Wei, said: “Taiwan is now the world’s fourth‑largest equity market and has generated massive wealth. We aim to accelerate Taiwan’s development in the Asian market, making it a hub for family offices and financial institutions to obtain high‑quality tokenized assets and to allocate assets using Taiwan‑approved stablecoins.”

AegisClear’s digital‑asset HSM custody solution combines security, scalability and compliance to manage and protect digital assets, safeguard cryptographic keys, and perform encryption operations. It holds SOC 2 certification and meets the technical specifications required by financial institutions for digital‑asset custody. Its architecture also complies with Taiwan’s VASP regulations and adheres to strict anti‑money‑laundering (AML) and know‑your‑customer (KYC) standards.
About AegisClear

AegisClear believes the next era of finance is not merely putting assets “on‑chain” but linking assets, capital, financial institutions and global markets to create greater trust, efficiency and accessibility. By connecting traditional financial assets, digital assets and stablecoin technology, AegisClear provides institutions with efficient, transparent and interoperable custody and settlement‑payment infrastructure.
The Aegis Group ecosystem includes Aegis Trust Company in the United States, the Digital Asset Clearing Center in Hong Kong ("DACC.HK"), and the Tokenization Foundation.

Aegis Trust Company offers digital‑asset custody, fiat on‑ and off‑ramps, custodial staking and tokenized‑asset services, subject to applicable laws, regulatory requirements and service availability. DACC.HK focuses on digital‑asset settlement infrastructure and cross‑border fintech applications, exploring digital bonds, stablecoins, central‑bank digital currencies (CBDC) and cross‑border payment technologies. The Tokenization Foundation is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization that created the world’s first tokenized‑currency market fund focused on social impact, supporting disaster response and humanitarian aid through AI and blockchain technology.
Website: http://aegisclear.com

紐約聯邦儲備銀行總裁威廉姆斯認為明年無需再加息，並據波士頓聯邦儲備銀行總裁柯林斯表示美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)官員意識到利率上升恐帶給金融機構問題，而且週三國際貨幣基金組織(IMF)總裁格奧爾基耶娃認為美國無法依靠強勁經濟成長降低赤字與國內生產總值(GDP)比例，需要加大財政整頓力度，令美元承壓，但胡塞組織持續對沙烏地阿拉伯發動導彈和無人機襲擊，加劇能源供應擔憂，導致油價維持高檔，而且指標十年期美國公債收益率觸及近兩周低點後持穩，激發美元的避險需求；此外，日本財務省財務官三村淳於IMF和世界銀行會議期間稱，東盟各國需應對能源衝擊和通貨膨脹等迫在眉睫的挑戰，認為日本亦應該提供財政支持，但有日本進口商和投機客買盤，推動美元兌日圓走高。

隨後美國勞工部數據顯示，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)分別較前月與上年同期漲0.6%及3.7%，核心CPI則分別較前月與去年同期擴大漲幅至0.3%及2.6%，價格壓力從能源領域向更廣泛領域蔓延，使FED在10月稍晚加息的可能性重新進入市場視野，提振美元兌日圓至158.94高點，但FED金融監管副主席鮑曼稱，在決定進一步行動前，還有時間觀望，而且FED在褐皮書中表示燃料成本上升加劇物價壓力，但重點反映房地產市場困境，打壓美元兌日圓至158.03低點。預估美元兌日圓阻力於158.00-20，支撐於156.80-157.00。
◆EUR/USD

昨日中國9月數據顯示，CPI較上年同期升0.9%為三個月高點，工業生產者出廠價格指數(PPI)則較去年同期漲0.5%創2022年6月來新高，同時以美元計價進、出口分別較上年同期增長31.0%及36.3%超過預期，改善風險偏好，並隨著市場消化澳洲央行(RBA)的9月會議紀錄的鷹派程度高於總裁布洛克上月加息後的表態，提供澳幣支撐，而且德國9月躉售物價較去年同期漲幅擴大至8.7%，帶動歐元兌美元觸及1.1211高點。

據歐洲央行(ECB)管理委員會委員溫施認為ECB仍需再升息，但ECB總裁拉加德表示法國應透過財政政策解決自身債券市場困境，淡化市場對ECB是否出手干預的猜測，更擔憂明年法國總統大選前政治角力可能阻礙政府削減高額赤字的努力，並據IMF敦促發達經濟體採取緊急行動削減政府支出、赤字和降低債務，而且美國CPI上漲激勵美元，打擊歐元兌美元至1.1112低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1200-20，支撐於1.1110-30。
◆GBP/USD

週三德勤(Deloitte)調查英國企業首席財務官(CFO)預計一年後通貨膨脹率升至3.4%及認為信貸成本高昂的比例創兩年半新高，而且法國財政問題衝擊歐元兌英鎊至十六個月新低，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3275高點。隨著英國央行(BOE)首席經濟學家皮爾稱市場對BOE未來一年加息四次、每次25個基點的推測過於激進，在美國CPI數據後，重創英鎊兌美元至1.3132低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3230-50，支撐於1.3130-50。
